Secondly, according to the phase characteristics of the current at both ends of the line under different fault types, the protection criteria that can identify the gold fault and the non-metal fault are constructed respectively, and the combination of the two forms a phase Angle differential protection method suitable for large-scale photovoltaic access in the distribution network. Finally, a 25-node actual distribution network model with photovoltaic access was built on MATLAB/Simulink. Under simulation conditions, the accuracy of protection action was 100%, which verified the effectiveness of the phase Angle differential protection method proposed in the paper.

articleTitle: A Time Division Operation Control Method for Energy Storage Considering Frequency Regulation Performance and SoC Management
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The combination of energy storage and traditional thermal power units can utilize energy storage auxiliary technology to improve the frequency regulation performance of traditional units and alleviate the peak shaving pressure of traditional units. This article proposes a phased control strategy that considers frequency modulation performance evaluation. Firstly, a control model for frequency regulation of auxiliary thermal power units in energy storage power stations was established. Secondly, set up detailed rules for energy storage operations in different periods, and based on this, consider energy storage State of Charge (SoC) management. Finally, simulations were conducted under the control strategies of no energy storage, full compensation, and phased control to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Topology Study and Loss Analysis of Orthogonal Controllable Reactor
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Quadrature controllable reactor is a kind of adjustable core reactor that regulates the size of inductance by adjusting the permeability of the working core, which has the characteristics of low harmonic content and linear inductance adjustment characteristics. In this paper, we investigate the topology of quadrature controllable reactor and analyze its losses. Firstly, we introduce its basic principle and topology, focusing on the working principle and circuit structure of the quadrature controllable reactor. Subsequently, we analyze the mechanism of STATCOM core loss in detail and propose a corresponding mathematical model. Using electromagnetic field simulation software, we conducted simulations and analyses on the iron core loss at various frequencies and control currents, and compared the results with the theoretical model. Finally, the correctness of the simulation results is verified by experiments, which validates the effectiveness of our proposed method for analyzing the iron core loss. The results of this paper are of great significance for optimizing the design and performance of quadrature controllable reactors.

articleTitle: Enhancing Stability in Wind Energy: A Robust H-infinity Approach for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Generators
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The prevailing PI-based control methodologies for permanent magnet synchronous generators (PMSG) are often plagued by challenges including the complexity of managing multiple input multiple output (MIMO) systems, susceptibility to integral saturation, and sensitivity to variations in system parameters. Addressing these issues, this paper introduces a novel H-infinity-based control strategy characterized by its straightforward design, which elegantly sidesteps the intricacies associated with MIMO system couplings. Additionally, this approach is analytically demonstrated to finely tune control parameters without the risk of integration saturation. Most critically, it showcases robustness against fluctuations in system parameters, marking a significant advancement in control strategies for wind power systems. The paper provides comprehensive mathematical modeling to underpin the proposed method, alongside simulation parameters and experimental outcomes that validate the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Hybrid DC Transformers and Its Active Control Method for DC Power Grids in Low-carbon Ports
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: For DC power grids with the bidirectional power flow in low-carbon ports, the high cost and low reliability of DC transformers based on active power devices seriously restrict the development and application of DC power grids. Based on the characteristics of bidirectional asymmetric power flow in ports, a hybrid DC transformer by integrating a unidirectional high-power uncontrolled rectification power path and a bidirectional low-power active power path is adopted, which can reduce system costs and improve system reliability as well as meeting power flow requirements. Besides, an active control method is researched and the operating modes is analyzed as well as the power transmission range comparison with the uncontrolled rectification mode. Finally, the above contents are conducted by simulation and experimental platforms. The preliminary results indicate that the proposed topology and active control method are feasible.

articleTitle: Analysis and Enlightenment of SF6 Electrical Equipment Alarming at Low Temperature
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In recent years, the global climate has changed significantly and extreme weather events have occurred frequently, which seriously affected the safe and stable operation of the power grid. At the beginning of 2010, the extreme low temperature weather caused alarm or locked of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> electrical equipment in many substations in Chengde, Zhangjiakou, and Qinhuangdao, and even whole substation was locked. Through the research on the performance of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas density relays in extreme low temperature conditions, the problems of low temperature locked had been obviously improved. From the end of 2020 to the beginning of 2021, two severe large-scale cold wave weather invaded North China, causing more than ten 500kV substations to have SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> electrical equipment low-pressure alarms or locked problems, the number of which exceeded 100times. This article analyzes the problems of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> electrical equipment in the cold wave weather in North China, and proposes measures and suggestions for SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> electrical equipment to cope with the cold wave climate, and introduces the content and key points of the life cycle management about SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas, providing a reference for the safe and stable operation of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> electrical equipment.

articleTitle: Research on the Vehicle Pile Matching Strategy Considering the User’s Charging Decision Behavior
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In the background of the rapid growth of the proportion of new energy, the number of electric vehicles increases accordingly, and the demand of users for rapid charging is also increasing day by day, but the problem of coordination and optimization of infrastructure still exists, and the problem of car and pile matching is becoming more and more important. In this regard, combined with the interests of charging operators and the charging needs of users, a real-time vehicle-pile matching strategy is proposed. Firstly, according to the charging time, distance and cost preference of users, the selection mechanism is designed to clarify the selection range of charging pile; secondly, the distribution function is constructed to provide real-time available pile information. Then a pile matching strategy is established to consider the charging decision behavior of users. Finally, the simulation examples verify that the strategy can better meet the interests of users and suppliers and help to realize the reasonable distribution of charging piles.

articleTitle: Optimization Method for Energy Storage System in Wind-solar-storage New Energy Power Station
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The volatility and randomness of new energy power generation such as wind and solar will inevitably lead to fluctuations and unpredictability of grid-connected power. By reasonably configuring energy storage units in wind and solar power stations, short-term fluctuations in the power of wind and solar power stations can be smoothed and the power quality of grid-connected power can be improved. Based on the smoothing control principle of the grid-connected power of wind and solar power station system, the minimum power and capacity configuration schemes of the energy storage system are determined respectively according to the maximum smoothing time constant of the first-order filtering method. In this method, the power and capacity of the energy storage in the wind-solar storage station system can be reasonably configured, and the energy storage system can be utilized to the maximum extent to achieve smoothing effect. The simulation model of wind-solar storage power station is built in Matlab, and the feasibility of the method is finally verified.

Author Keywords: configuration of the energy storage system

articleTitle: Active Junction Temperature Control Strategy for Si IGBT/SiC MOSFET Hybrid Switches
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The Si IGBT/SiC MOSFET hybrid switches composed of large-capacity Si IGBT and small-capacity SiC MOSFET in parallel can achieve an effective compromise between high efficiency and low cost, which is of great significance for breaking through the limitations of single power devices. The lifetime of Si/SiC hybrid switches can be significantly extended by thermal control. However, the existing thermal control technologies are mainly for single Si-based and SiC-based devices. The loss distribution of Si/SiC hybrid switches with various junction temperature control parameters is not clear. Based on this, this paper proposes an Active Junction Temperature Control (ATC) strategy for Si/SiC hybrid switches. Firstly, two junction temperature control methods of Si/SiC hybrid switches are analyzed and discussed. The switching frequency f and the full current conduction ratio r of Si IGBT are selected to carry out junction temperature fluctuation smoothing. Secondly, under the small range fluctuation of load and the large range fluctuation of load, the (f, r) parameter group under the next stage load condition is obtained based on the interpolation method with the minimum junction temperature fluctuation as the control target. Finally, the simulation results show that at least 35% of the junction temperature fluctuation of the Si/SiC hybrid switches is smoothed under the proposed thermal control strategy.

articleTitle: Magnetic Balance Differential Protection Scheme for Sen Transformer Based on Magnetic Circuit Coupling
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Sen transformer, functioning as a power flow controller, adjusts the amplitude and phase of voltage and current at its terminal points by varying its tap position. However, due to its complex and compact connection topology and internal structure, Sen transformers present more intricate fault characteristics compared to conventional power transformers, posing challenges for their protection system configuration. To address this issue, this paper, based on the analysis of its topology and electromagnetic induction principles, proposes a magnetic balance differential protection scheme for Sen transformers. By installing Current Transformers (CTs) at the output and the end of the excitation winding, the proposed scheme enables the detection of inter-winding and winding-ground faults in Sen transformers, effectively alleviating the difficulty in configuring their main body protection. A PSCAD/EMTDC simulation platform was employed to verify the validity of the scheme, providing theoretical support for further research and practical applications of Sen transformers.

articleTitle: The Measurement System of Electricity Price Affordability for Industrial Users in the Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the progress of electricity market reform and low-carbon energy transition, there is an upward trend in the level of electricity prices for consumers. Therefore, it is urgent to conduct an analysis of consumers' affordability of electricity prices to assist the government in more scientifically formulating the pricing mechanism for the electricity market and guide electricity suppliers in developing more reasonable retail strategies. This paper focuses on industrial users who are more sensitive to changes in electricity prices. Firstly, through literature research and empirical analysis, it identifies the main factors that affect the affordability of electricity prices for industrial users. Secondly, a measurement system based on the Dynamic CRITIC-Entropy (DCE) Model is established. Finally, using data from a province in China as an example for simulation calculations, the validity of the model is verified.

articleTitle: Optimized Operation Model of Urban Energy Internet with Multi-Category Energy Subsystems via Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Upon connecting numerous renewable power sources to the power grid, the inherent high randomness and volatility in renewable energy often result in challenges such as unbalanced power supply, diminished power quality, and unstable operational statuses. These challenges significantly elevate the complexity of urban energy operation and management. Moreover, with each micro energy network system catering to different energy preferences, conventional management practices within a single energy category must evolve to address multi-category energy optimization and control. This paper proposes an optimization and control framework for the urban energy internet, encompassing multi-category energy subsystems. Firstly, it formulates an optimization model for the urban energy internet aimed at maximizing integrated value across various energy categories. Secondly, it employs a model predictive control algorithm that relies on a two-time prediction domain for continuous optimization. Validation of the proposed optimization method is conducted using the modified IEEE 30-bus system distributed micro energy network. The results demonstrate that the proposed method optimizes the micro energy network with respect to their preferences.

articleTitle: A Novel Fault Ride Through Strategy based on Multidimensional Information for MMC-VSC HVDC System
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The large-scale development and utilization of long-distance offshore wind power is one of the most mature renewable energy technologies. More and more offshore wind farms are integrated into the onshore utility network by MMC-VSC HVDC system. Moreover, the electrochemical energy storage system is increasingly involved in power assistance services and MMC-VSC HVDC system is a better system accessing mode. The HVDC system with small capacity is mostly connected to the grid through a single AC outgoing line. And, the MMC-VSC HVDC system will work in the open-phase condition during the AC line reclosing period. The conventional AC fault ride through strategy may fail and result in outage of the MMC-VSC HVDC system. In this paper, open-phase running of MMC-VSC HVDC system is analysed and the converter control process is researched in detail. A novel fault ride through strategy based on multi-dimensional information is proposed. Simulation model is built based on PSCAD/EMTDC. Several cases are studied to verify the feasibility and validity of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Test Method for High-Power Microwave Irradiation Effects in Millimeter-Wave Proximity Detector
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: High-Power Microwave (HPM) is an emerging technology formed by the development of electrotechnology, traditional microwave, plasma physics, and other related fields, which has very important applications in the military field. With the formal entry of the HPM weapon into the battlefield, it is of great practical significance to study the HPM effects in susceptible electronic systems such as the detector. To objectively evaluate the ability of a certain type of millimeter-wave proximity detector to resist HPM electromagnetic pulse jamming, an HPM irradiation system for the proximity detector was constructed, and a method of real-time storage of proximity detector output potentials using a compact online recording device has been provided. Based on that, the paper carries out the HPM irradiation test of the K-band proximity detector and enriches the means of irradiation effect data recording for small electronic devices.

articleTitle: Optimized Layout of the Surge Arresters on the Outlet Line of Substation under Continuous Lightning Strikes
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Continuous lightning strikes are widespread in nature and are one of the primary sources of substation failures. As a critical power system component, substations require adequate protection against lightning strikes to ensure grid reliability. Using Surge Arresters (SAs) for lightning protection is a cost-effective and straightforward approach. However, the current protection level provided by SAs is insufficient to withstand continuous lightning strikes and needs further improvement. With the premise that the electrical distance between SAs and circuit breakers is within the specified range, achieving a lower residual voltage for the SAs is essential to improve their lightning protection capabilities. This paper introduces an optimized layout method for SAs on the outlet line of the substation to reduce the residual voltage, thereby enhancing the protection level against continuous lightning strikes. By implementing this method, substations can better withstand the challenges posed by continuous lightning strikes and ensure uninterrupted power supply to consumers.

articleTitle: Passive Temperature Threshold Sensors Based on RFID and Shape Memory Polymer for Power System Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The sensing technology of the power system promotes the deep integration of energy network and data information and helps to build a new type of power system with deep integration of digital and system. It can ensure the stable operation of the power grid. RFID sensors are widely used as passive wireless sensors. While they still face the disadvantage of missing data information when the reader is not actively interrogated. In this paper, a shape memory polymer material is introduced and its thermo-mechanical property of deformation recovery above and below the glass transition temperature is exploited to design a temperature threshold sensor. By measuring the backscatter power of the RFID tag, whether the target exceeds the threshold temperature could be determined. This method can record historical information in a non-electric form when the reader is not actively interrogated, facilitating quick problem solving or troubleshooting. In this paper, a prototype of the SMP material was fabricated using 3D printing technology. And several reader-tag temperature threshold detection experiments at different distances were conducted. The results show that the SMP material recovers its deformation near 60 °C in the reader antenna field range. And the backscatter power amplitude of the two tags is significantly flipped. This validates the feasibility of temperature threshold sensors. When electrical equipment malfunctions lead to high temperatures, temperature threshold sensors can detect the malfunction and solve the hidden problem.

articleTitle: Multi-arm Bandit-based Electric Vehicle Energy Management Considering User Behavior Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The effective energy management of Electric Vehicles (EVs) can optimize energy utilization and promote the systematic operation of the power grid. However, the uncertainty and stochasticity of EV users’ charging/discharging behaviors may deviate from the desired goals and cause unnecessary costs, deteriorating the energy management performance. Therefore, a strategic EV energy management based on the Multi-Arm Bandit (MAB) approach is proposed in the present study to maximize the profit of each EV. In the proposed MAB model, the behaviors of each EV user are considered as three arms. Under the EV battery safety threshold, the optimal arm is selected to achieve cost savings. The case study shows that the approach can fully satisfy the user’s charging demand and obtain the optimal strategy through online decision-making.

articleTitle: A Generator Start-up Method of Distribution System Considering Users’ Preferences and V2G
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In the post-disaster fault scenario, the decentralized large-scale Electric Vehicles (EVs) in the city have considerable discharge potential, which can support generators restarting after blackouts in Distributions System (DS), accelerate the procedure of DS restoration. However, it’s hard to coordinate the consistency of such a large number of EV users, research about guidance of EV users is needed. A generator start-up method of DS considering users’ preferences and Vehicle to Grid (V2G) is proposed in this paper. First, the process of EV users' preferences in DS genera-tor restoration is analyzed, and then the key factors affecting EV users' preferences in restoration are proposed, and a guiding decision-making model considering EV users' preferences is established. Then, constraints of generator ramping, system restoration status and EV discharging are considered, a generator start-up model of distribution system considering users’ preferences and V2G is built. Finally, the modified IEEE 33 node test system verifies that the proposed method can effectively solve the restoration strategy, decreasing generator start-up time, enhance resilience of DS.

articleTitle: Optimal Economic Operation of Microgrid Considering Demand Response and Improved Salp Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to reduce the power generation cost of microgrid, an economic scheduling model based on demand response is proposed in this paper. First of all, based on the peak valley time of use electricity price, the Demand Response (DR) is established. On this basis, an Improved Salp Swarm Algorithm (ISSA) is proposed to solve the problem that the traditional algorithm is easy to fall into local optimal. The crazy operator is introduced to update the position of leaders. In the formula of follower's position update, the strategy based on inertia weight is proposed to balance the global exploration and local explotation capabilities of the algorithm. The simulation results show that the model can effectively reduce the power generation cost, promote the economic operation of microgrid, and verify the effectiveness of the improved algorithm.

articleTitle: The Effect of Combined Aging on the Degradation Characteristics of Partial Discharge in Oil-Pressboard Insulation under Composite Voltage
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The converter transformer is the key equipment of the UHV DC transmission system. Its operating status is crucial for the safe and stable operation of the transmission system. The degradation of the main insulation on the valve side of the converter transformer is complex under the AC-DC voltage. Among them, partial discharge is an important cause and characterization of the deterioration of oil-pressboard insulation. A combined aging experimental platform for oil-pressboard insulation and a partial discharge experimental platform under AC-DC voltage is built. The partial discharge characteristics of oil-pressboard insulation at different aging statuses are studied. The influence of aging degree on partial discharge is analyzed. The results can provide a reference for fault diagnosis and condition evaluation of oil-pressboard insulation in converter transformers.

articleTitle: High Frequency Simulation Modeling of CVT Based on Improved Grey Wolf Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the continuous development of new energy sources, new requirements are proposed for the measurement accuracy of Capacitor Voltage Transformer (CVT) in different working conditions. This paper analyzes the structure and operating characteristics of CVT in high and low frequency conditions. In order to solve the problem that the stray capacitance parameters of CVT are difficult to be determined at high frequency, a parameter identification method based on improved grey wolf optimization is proposed. This method can identify the stray capacitance of CVT accurately. At the same time, the equivalent scaling model of CVT is established, and simulation experiments are carried out according to multiple groups of CVT data, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Deep Neural Network Based Method for Predicting Active Transmission Constraints in SCUC
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Security-Constrained Unit Commitment (SCUC) stands as a critical challenge within power systems. With the continual expansion of power networks, SCUC encounters substantial hurdles in terms of computational time. In practical scenarios, given the imperative of electricity market clearance, this dilemma necessitates frequent resolution throughout the day despite minor alterations in input data. In this study, leveraging machine learning techniques, we present an approach aimed at harnessing previous data effectively to forecast active constraints, thus expediting solutions to the SCUC problem. We introduce a novel methodology for generating training data to predict the active transmission constraint set, ensuring the trained model achieves full prediction coverage. Through extensive computational simulations, our approach demonstrates a remarkable acceleration in computation speed, achieving up to 8 times the efficiency in large-scale scenarios.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Based on Single-phase H-bridge Converter Series Active Voltage Arc Suppression Scheme
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The existing active arc suppression device for single-phase ground faults in the distribution network needs to withstand the full fault-phase voltage, leading to issues such as a large number of required components, complex structure, and high costs. Based on the working principle of the series active voltage arc suppression scheme, this paper proposes an active voltage arc suppression method based on a single-phase H-bridge converter and an arc suppression coil connected in series to the neutral point of the distribution network. The mathematical model of the control loop of the active arc suppression device was developed, and the pi and repetitive control strategy was used to optimize the dynamic response characteristics of the voltage loop. The simulation results show that the improved control strategy effectively suppresses the fault residual current, and the voltage the device withstands is only 5.91%~9.1% of the fault phase voltage. The proposed method is effective in single-phase ground faults in distribution networks under different transition resistances. Both can effectively suppress fault arcs.

articleTitle: Profit Improvement of A Low-Carbon Integrated Energy System with Electric-Hydrogen Hybrid Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: It is of great significance to build a low-carbon integrated energy system of electric-hydrogen coordination for the clean and low-carbon future power energy system. In this paper, a comprehensive energy system optimization model of electric-hydrogen energy storage coupling and low-carbon cooperation is constructed. First, a mathematical model is constructed for each energy conversion equipment, and the coupling and complementarity between electrothermal hydrogen energy is realized by constructing hydrogen-mixed natural gas CHP unit and GB unit model, and then the load is decouped by electric-hydrogen energy storage. Finally, a carbon trading model is constructed to realize the overall low carbonization of the system. The entire mathematical optimization model was solved by using CPLEX solver. After verifying the proposed hydrogen blending optimization model, the system operating cost was reduced by 13.95% and carbon emissions by 12.63%. After adopting the electrohydrogen energy storage coupling cooperative carbon trading optimization model, the system operating cost was further reduced by 3.76%. Carbon emissions were further reduced by 1.61%.

articleTitle: Extremely Compact Cell Pitch Design of a Novel Full-P Encapsulated 4H-SiC Trench MOSFET With N-P-N Sandwich Epitaxial Wafers
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In this study, we have designed a novel Full-P encapsulated 4H-SiC trench MOSFET with N-P-N sandwich epitaxial wafers. This is the first time that extremely compact cell pitch design is used in a SiC trench MOSFET with N-P-N sandwich epitaxial wafers. The detailed parameter design of the N-P-N sandwich epitaxial layer is presented. The electric field is modulated jointly by the P+ buried layer on either side of the N+ enrich region and the p-shield region at the bottom of the trench in the device. This can better improve the gate reliability. At the same time, the pitch of the cell is only 1.5 μm, which will be achievable on future process platforms. Furthermore, the effect of the doping and width of the N+ enrich region on the breakdown characteristics and output characteristics of the device is investigated in depth. It is found that when the N+ enrich doping is 3.0 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> and the width is 0.6 μm, the device has the optimal electrical characteristics. At this point, the breakdown voltage of the device is 1620 V, and the maximum electric field at the bottom of the gate oxide is 2.83 MV/cm. The specific on-resistance is 1.34 mΩ•cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, and the BFOM is as high as 1.96 GW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Finally, the process design of the proposed novel structure is completed based on the existing process. This cell structure design has advantages for reducing cell pitch and improving the conduction characteristics of future devices.

articleTitle: Research on Cable Arc Fault of Parallel Overhead Line–Cable Hybrid Line with Auto-reclosing
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Following an arc fault occurrence in the cable section of an overhead line–cable hybrid line, the cable arc fault is reignited by auto-reclosing, and the process of cable arc fault is different in various auto-reclosing strategies. In this paper, based on a practical parallel hybrid line system in Guangdong, China, a single-phase grounding arc fault was simulated to compare the process of cable grounding arc fault under the Single-Phase Auto-Reclosing (SPAR) and Three-Phase Auto-Reclosing (TPAR) strategies. Results showed that when SPAR is selected, five typical stages are involved, for which the total arcing time of the primary arc, secondary arc, and reclose arc is 0.52 s for the studied system. However, the total arcing time in TPAR is only 0.14 s, primarily because there is no secondary arc present on the cable in this case. Therefore, compared with TPAR, SPAR with more than three times the arcing time and more energy geniture from the secondary arc poses a considerably increased risk of cables being ignited by arcs and the likelihood of tunnel fires.

articleTitle: Optimization Strategy for Multi-scenario Grid Security Support Considering Large-Scale Electric Vehicle Access
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to enhance the capacity of the distribution network to accommodate large-scale electric vehicle charging loads, and at the same time to mitigate the adverse impacts of disorderly charging of electric vehicles, it is necessary to take corresponding measures to guide and control the random charging behavior. This paper adopts a two-layer optimal scheduling model for orderly charging and discharging of EVs, which not only maximizes the benefits of EV users, but also produces a positive effect on the safe and stable operation of the power grid with reasonable scheduling control. The coordination between the two-layer optimal scheduling ensures the safety of the power grid and the users, so as to realize the orderly charging and discharging control of electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Economic Impact of Storage and Photovoltaic Generation on Residential Energy Systems: A Geometric Method and Its Implications
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: This paper quantifies the economic impact of storage and photovoltaic (PV) generation in residential energy systems. In the daily operation problem, the power and energy capacity of the energy storage unit and the installed capacity of PV panel are regarded as parameters, giving rise to a multi-parametric linear program (mp-LP). Based on the dual theory, a linear programming based algorithm is developed to retrieve the parametric optimal value function of the daily operation problem, which describes the economic impact of energy storage and PV generation geometrically. Case studies validate the proposed method and give some implications of the proposed method, such as visualization and sizing system components.

articleTitle: Applicability Analysis of Wave Head Reflection Coefficient Spectrum in Fault Location of Wind Farm Collection Cable
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Because there are many branches on the collection line of wind farms, and the distribution distance of each wind turbine on the collection line is different, the traditional cable fault location method cannot be used. Therefore, the applicability of wave head reflection coefficient spectrum in fault location of wind farms with multi-branch structure is analyzed in this paper. First, based on the cable distribution parameter model, the location principle of the fault cable with single branch fault is analyzed, and the reflection coefficient spectrum of the fault cable is obtained. Then, the fault location function is constructed by converting the real part of the reflection coefficient spectrum from the frequency domain to the spatial domain by the generalized orthogonal integral method. Finally, the simulation results show that the proposed method has high accuracy in identifying impedance change points such as fault points, cable branch points and wind turbine access points.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Multi-Energy Complementary Microgrid with Carbon Trading
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to achieve economic/environmental benefits of the microgrid, a carbon trading mechanism was added to the optimal scheduling model of multi-energy complementary microgrid which includes wind/PV power units, gas-fired units, diesel units and batteries. In the proposed scheduling model, both the operation cost and environment cost were minimized as well as operation constrains were satisfied. Moreover, particle swarm optimization algorithm was adopted for solving the optimal scheduling problem. Finally, case studies were carried out in several scenarios to verify the proposed optimal scheduling model. Carbon trading cost with and without wind/PV power as well as various cost using different objectives were analyzed. Furthermore, the results show that operation cost, environmental cost and carbon trading cost were reduced by 7.5%, 11.3% and 36.7%, respectively due to the carbon trading mechanism.

articleTitle: Analysis of Penetration Capacity of Renewable Energy Grid Connected Nodes Based on Minimum Wind Power Curtailment
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Aiming at the fluctuation of wind power generation in the new energy grid connection, an analysis method for the accommodation capacity of long-distance wind farm line power congestion and minimum wind curtailment is proposed. An optimization model considering the participation of aggregate load and the constraints of voltage and power double overrun is constructed. A solution method considering primal dual interior point algorithm is proposed to solve the double overrun coupling problem. Finally, the improved ieee33 node model is used to reduce the wind curtailment rate by about 25%, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Multi-stage Transmission-Storage Collaboration Planning Schemes for Real Power Grids
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the rapid development of large wind power and photovoltaic base in desert, Gobi and desert areas in the west of our country, wind power and photovoltaic energy delivery become an important problem to be solved urgently. In this paper, multi-stage transmission-storage cooperative planning model is carried out for the real power grid, and a comprehensive evaluation indicators system is proposed from four dimensions of economy, reliability, cleanliness and flexibility. The results show that developing renewable energy is helpful to improve the operating performance of the power grid and enhance the comprehensive benefits of the system.

articleTitle: Angle Resetting Control for Virtual Synchronous Generator with Limits of Frequency
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Due to the narrow operational domain of the Voltage Source Converter (VSC), it is necessary to implement frequency limitations to prevent damage to the equipment and to maintain the stability of the system. This paper provides new insights for rationally setting frequency limits to ensure the transient stability of Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG). First, the grid-connected VSG dynamic model with frequency restrictions and subsystem switched model are developed. It is shown that the system's frequency-limited trajectories leave away from boundaries at two specified points which are fixed irrespective of the switching times. According to the Lyapunov theory, if the leaving bound points have less energy than that of the Unstable Equilibrium Points (UEP), the limited system can remain stable. As a result, the stability of the system can be ensured by adjusting the upper and lower boundaries of the frequency. Moreover, since the energy of the SEP only has kinetic energy, which is minimal among all the leaving bound points, resetting the angle of VSG to its SEP once the limits of frequency are reached can ensure the system always stabilize at the initial period of the angle.

articleTitle: Robust Optimization Coordinated Optimal UPFC and Unit Dispatch Considering Wind Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The UPFC with the characteristics of flexible controllability and fast response is beneficial to improve the flexible ability engaged in the power system operating, the solution of power dispatch is depicted as the coordinate operation of source side, grid side and load side. This paper proposes a union optimization method for robust planning considering the optimal location-allocations of UPFC to improve the flexible operating ability of power system and reduce the risk of wind curtailment and load shedding. Firstly, based on the static operating characteristics of UPFC and non-Convex and nonlinear characteristics of AC power flow, a convex model of power flow considering UPFC is established to improve the accuracy of power flow calculation; Secondly, based on the ability of UPFC, a joint model considering optimal UPFC and optimal dispatch is presented with the uncertainty of wind. Then, based on the strong dual theory and linear relaxation method, the column and constraint generation algorithm is introduced to convert the original model into a two-stage problem to be solved. Finally, the modified IEEE RTS 24 bus system is introduced to verify the rationality and effectiveness of the proposed model, the simulation proved the optimal UPFC is beneficial to improve the dispatch economy and reduce the wind curtailment and load shedding.

articleTitle: Case Study of Microgrid Operation in the Context of Environment and Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The global energy crisis and environmental crisis have led to the rapid development of new energy, especially in the context of China's dual carbon strategy target in 2020, the next few decades, the new energy industry in China's energy structure will account for an increasingly high proportion. In order to support the realization of the "double carbon" goal, wind power, photovoltaic and other new energy will play an irreplaceable role. However, a large number of new energy sources connected to the power grid will have some impact on the characteristics of the power system. In order to study the operating characteristics of multiple new energy sources connected to the microgrid, this paper builds a microgrid control simulation platform containing various distributed power sources such as solar, wind, small hydropower, thermal voltaic, and energy storage. The simulation platform is used to study the operating characteristics of various new energy sources in different seasons, load changes and storage capacity changes. The results show that the power output of various new energy sources is influenced by environmental factors, especially photovoltaic, wind power and thermal voltages; energy storage capacity also has an impact on the microgrid system. The research results provide theoretical support for the intelligent control and integrated management of microgrid with multiple new energy sources.

articleTitle: Research on Magnetic Field Calculation and Protective Area of Bridge Arm Reactors
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Voltage Source Converter-based High Voltage Direct Current (VSC-HVDC) systems are widely used and the bridge arm reactor is a key component of the transmission converter station in these systems. Dry-type air-core structure bridge arm reactors have significant advantages but suffer from severe leakage flux, posing potential safety risks to maintenance personnel. Optimizing the reactor structure or designing magnetic field shielding structures using finite element algorithms is a commonly researched solution. However, these methods have longer development cycles and higher costs. Therefore, this paper establishes the single-phase two-dimensional axisymmetric and three-phase simplified three-dimensional simulation models of the bridge arm reactor. Considering the operational requirements for maintenance personnel, the magnetic field distribution around the reactor at a height of 1.8m above the ground is calculated by using the multi-physics field calculation software TR-Sim V2024. Based on relevant standards, two specific protection measures are proposed. By accurately setting the range of protection signs, the cost of the protection measures is reduced while ensuring the safety of maintenance personnel, providing valuable assistance for project implementation.

articleTitle: Study of the Voltage Levels in the Nodes of A Single-Loop Network with Connected Renewable Decentralized Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The paper considers the determination of the voltage levels in hybrid medium voltage electric power distribution networks and more specifically in branches with connected renewable decentralized energy sources. After connecting the decentralized energy sources, sections with more than one power supply appear in the branches, which becomes a challenge for the operating personnel. This leads to a change in the structure of the network, its mode parameters, and also requires introduction of adjustments to the relay protection. The proposed software will be of use for engineers, operating with hybrid electrical networks and for students in their preparation for designing, reconstructing and working with similar networks, whose number is increasingly going up. It will also facilitate the choice of an optimal configuration for power supplying consumers in post-emergency situations.

articleTitle: An Optimized Management Model for User Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to promote multi energy complementarity and build low-carbon parks, a carbon emission control model that considers the cooperation between waste incineration power plants and sewage treatment plants is established in this paper. In response to the large amount of carbon dioxide generated during the incineration process of power plants and the treatment process of sewage treatment plants, effective recovery of carbon dioxide is achieved through flue gas treatment, electricity to gas conversion, and biogas purification, while generating natural gas. By utilizing carbon trading mechanisms, load shifting can be achieved through joint control of electricity to gas conversion, flue gas treatment, biogas purification energy consumption, and other controllable loads, thereby stabilizing fluctuations in new energy. Considering the carbon trading mechanism, an optimization control model with the goal of minimizing carbon trading costs was constructed. Based on the CPLEX solver, multiple scenarios were simulated and analyzed for comparison, proving that the proposed model can effectively reduce carbon emissions and has a certain promoting effect on the construction of low-carbon parks.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Industrial Production Equipment Optimization Scheduling for Multiple Energy Demands
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Under the goal of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality come up by the Chinese government, energy conservation and emission reduction has become one of the primary strategic objectives of the current energy industry. The manufacturing industry, as the main source of energy consumption and environmental pollutant emissions, urgently needs to improve processes to increase energy utilization rate. Therefore, an industrial production equipment optimization scheduling method considering types of energy-consuming devices and corresponding energy demands is proposed. This method can not only meet the manufacturing requirements of the factory, but also reduce the energy use cost. Firstly, according to the energy consumption characteristics of production equipment, the equipment is classified and the energy demand model is proposed. Secondly, an industrial production scheduling and comprehensive energy consumption optimization model considering energy conversion equipment, resource storage, operating constraints, and production targets is proposed. Finally, a case study for the cement production process is conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Frequency NADIR Estimation for An Offshore Wind-Thermal-Energy Storage Combined Output Systems Based on An Equivalent Model
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Frequency nadir is an important index to evaluate frequency stability of a power systems. However, for systems including offshore wind power and energy storage, methods for predicting the frequency nadir are rely on detail simulation and lacks of rapid prediction methods. Focuses on an offshore Wind-Thermal-Energy Storage combined output power system (WTESPWRS), this paper proposes a method to estimate the frequency nadir, based on a constructed equivalent model. In detail, first, the offshore wind-thermal-energy storage combined output system is introduced. And then, the models for the component of the WTESPWRS are presented. Furthermore, based on the SFR (Synthetic Frequency Response) model, an improved SFR model capable of estimating the system's frequency domain response and frequency nadir is deduced. Finally, with simulations results under various conditions, the performance of the enhanced SFR model is validated, demonstrating its effectiveness, and the impact of energy storage capacity and control parameters on frequency nadir is explored.

articleTitle: A Cosine Similarity-based Fault Direction Discrimination Method for Distribution Networks with A High Proportion of Photovoltaic Sources
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the high proportion of Photovoltaic (PV) power sources connected to the distribution networks, the distribution network becomes a complex network with multiple power supplies, and the reverse-feeding effect of PV sources can lead to reverse maloperation of generally configured current protection. Therefore, the direction criterion is introduced to solve this problem. However, the traditional power direction criterion has the problem of maloperation under the influence of PV equivalent impedance. Therefore, this paper deduces the fault equivalent impedance of PV sources, and clarifies the influence mechanism of PV sources on the traditional power direction criterion. Then, based on the cosine similarity characteristics of the positive sequence voltage and current at protection installation, a fast direction protection method based on single terminal quantity is proposed. Finally, simulation cases based on PSCAD/EMTDC simulation platform are carried out to fully demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method and its superiority over the traditional power direction criterion.

articleTitle: Improved Double Closed-loop Control Strategy for Micro-grid Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the double closed-loop energy storage control strategy cannot accurately control the bus voltage when dealing with large load fluctuations, this paper proposes an improved double closed-loop control strategy. By adding a power control link and introducing a power adjustment parameter in the voltage outer loop, it can improve the accurate judgment of the charging and discharging state of the energy storage and improve the stability of the bus voltage.

articleTitle: Economic Capacity Assessment of Renewable Energy in Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Assessing the capacity of distributed generation connected to the distribution network is a challenge in constructing new type power systems. Based on the robust optimization method, considering the safe operation and economic objectives, the capacity of distributed power generation and energy storage is optimized. According to historical data and probability distribution of the uncertain wind, solar and load, multiple scenarios of these uncertainties are generated, and the uncertainty set is established to construct operation scenarios. Then, based on the uncertainty set, a two-level robust optimization model is established. The economically worst operation scenario in the uncertainty set is searched by the outer-level model. The capacity of wind, solar and energy storage in the worst scenario is optimized by the inner-level model, taking into account the security constraints of distribution network. Compared with the capacity allocation results of the traditional method, the capacities allocated in this paper are smaller, and can meet the safe operation of the distribution network, with higher economic performance.

articleTitle: Control Strategies for Grid-connected/off-grid Smooth Switch of VSG-based Energy Storage Systems in Low-carbon Ports
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: A energy storage system (ESS) is the important part of integrated energy systems (IES) in low-carbon ports to flatten the power fluctuations of renewable energy sources and ensure the continuous power supply for kinds of loads. It can operate in the grid-connected mode to exchange power with the port grids, and in off-grid mode to provide uninterruptible power for loads. In order to realize grid-connected/off-grid smooth switch of the ESS with the virtual synchronous generator (VSG) technology, a flexible grid-connected/off-grid control strategy is studied. Firstly, the topology and the control system of the ESS are presented. Then, the pre-synchronization control method is adopted to regulate the voltage amplitude, phase and frequency before grid-connected action. By this way, the inrush current during the grid-connected/off-grid switch is effectively reduced. Finally, a VSG-based ESS is built on the MATLAB/Simulink platform and the effectiveness of the adopted control strategy is verified.

articleTitle: A Preliminary Study on the Application of Large Language Models in Power System Simulations
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The digital update of power systems requires the support of intelligent application systems. Therefore, this paper investigates the utilization of a cutting-edge artificial intelligence technology called the Large Language Model (LLM) in power system simulations. The study provides a comprehensive overview of the key techniques employed in developing advanced simulation applications using LLMs, including retrieval-augmented generation and chain-of-thought prompting. Moreover, the paper showcases the development of two intelligent simulation applications on the CloudPSS, which is a high-performance cloud simulation platform for energy internet. The process of application development is described in detail, and the operational outcomes are presented to demonstrate the initial validation of the LLM's ability to initiate simulation tools and generate simulation codes.

articleTitle: Research on Load Aggregator Participation in Virtual Power Plant Optimization Scheduling Considering Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The current new power system in China is in a transitional stage from the "source follows load" mode to the "source network load storage collaborative interaction" mode. In this context, how to make reasonable use of load side flexible scheduling resources has become a new issue and challenge facing the construction of a new future power system. This article first proposes a specific architecture of a virtual power plant that takes into account demand response and load aggregation merchants, incorporating supply side distributed energy and demand side adjustable loads into the control scope of the virtual power plant. Secondly, in order to fully awaken the potential for flexible scheduling of resources on the demand side, an in-depth analysis is conducted on the electricity consumption characteristics of electric vehicles and industrial and commercial user demand response resources. On this basis, a dual layer optimization scheduling model for virtual power plants considering load aggregation quotient and demand response was designed based on the customer baseline load curve prediction method using latin hypercube sampling and K-means++, clarifying the roles and interactive objects of each unit in the control range of virtual power plants. In this double-layer model, the upper layer optimizes scheduling with the goal of maximizing the net profit of virtual power plants, and the lower layer simulates market clearing with the goal of maximizing the net profit of load aggregators. Based on the characteristics of the proposed model, the constructed double-layer model is simplified into a linear programming problem through KKT conditions, duality theory, and the large M method. The numerical analysis verifies the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed dual layer model for virtual power plants.

articleTitle: Study on Data Center Wind-Storage-Load-Grid System Optimization Considering Time-of-use Prices
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The data center is generally a large-scale industrial power load with small fluctuations and high green energy target. It is very suitable to be built in the areas with rich renewable energy resources and adopts the integrated development model of renewable power source, battery storage, power load and power grid. This paper constructs a time-series production simulation model to optimize the integrated source-grid-load-storage system while considering time-of-use electricity prices. Power supply cost of the system is taken as the objective and the relationship between system cost and power grid supply rate is given as the result. Time-of-use electricity price is used as incentive signal to optimize the time and operation of battery storage in regulating wind power output and participating in power grid interaction. Finally, a data center park powered by an integrated system of wind-battery-grid is selected to verify the correctness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Data-Driven Dynamic State Estimation Method for Modular Multilevel Converters Using Koopman Operator
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of modular multilevel converters (MMCs) in new power systems, having knowledge of rapid real-time dynamic states has become crucial to system protection and stability control. In this paper, a novel data-driven dynamic state estimation (DSE) method based on Koopman operator is proposed to estimate the dynamic states of MMCs. First, a back-to-back modular multilevel converter based high-voltage direct current (MMC-HVDC) transmission system is built in RTLAB. The data of state variables is derived form a hardware-in the-loop testing. Then, the state variables are elevated to high-dimensional space by observable functions, which evolve linearly in the observable space. Finally, the states in the observable space are mapped back to the state-space to achieve the DSE. The simulation results show that the method has good accuracy and robustness for the nonlinear and uncertainty of the model.

articleTitle: Active Power Emergency Control Strategy Considering the Residual Power Support Capacity of Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The fault disconnection of some units in large-scale wind farms is likely to cause high-power shortage, which may lead to the maximum transient frequency deviation of the system exceeding the action threshold of two or three lines of defense, resulting in load loss. Facing the problem of short-term transient frequency over-limit under fault conditions, it is an effective strategy to participate in the emergency control of power grid by secondary regulation of the residual power support capacity of wind power with power reserve. Firstly, the frequency response model of wind turbine participating in secondary regulation is established, and the basis for judging the action of secondary regulation is given. Secondly, by considering the actual operation of wind turbines and various evaluation indicators, the units are sorted to determine the units participating in the regulation and the power distribution of the units. On this basis, the strategy process of wind power participating in the emergency control of secondary regulation is proposed. Finally, based on the simulation software, the feasibility of the proposed strategy is verified, and the effectiveness of the proposed allocation method is compared with the traditional method.

articleTitle: A Novel Coupled-inductor-based Switched Capacitor DC-DC Converter with High Gain Ratio and High Efficiency for PV Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel high step-up DC-DC converter topology that is especially suited for grid-connected photovoltaic (PV) systems. The proposed converter architecture utilizes only one active switch in a coupled-inductor-based switched capacitor converter, to achieve a substantial increase in voltage gain. The design employs a unique strategy where capacitors adjacent to the secondary winding are charged in parallel and subsequently discharged in series, contributing to a portion of the output voltage. Concurrently, additional boost and buck-boost capacitors are charged and then discharged in series with the primary voltage source to effectively augment the total output voltage. A significant feature of the proposed converter is the series integration of these two voltage contributions, enabling the attainment of a high voltage gain while maintaining an optimal duty cycle. Moreover, the boost and buck-boost capacitors are engineered to capture the energy from leakage inductances, thereby minimizing the voltage stress across the switch. This reduction in voltage stress leads to lower switching losses. Simulation and experimental results with a 96% peak efficiency are provided to validate the proposed topology.

articleTitle: Topology Optimization of A 252 kV GIS Supporting Insulator for Addressing Electrode/Epoxy Interfacial Electric Field Stress
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Complex service environments subject the GIS supporting insulators to a variety of hazards concurrently. Intensified electrical stress at electrode/epoxy interface could cause insulation failure, incurring catastrophic consequences to the power system. Topology optimization method was adopted to address the electrical stress inhomogeneity by optimizing spatial distribution of material properties. Firstly, a simplified two-dimensional simulation model of a 252 kV supporting insulator was established and its effectiveness was validated by comparing with the actual three-dimensional model. Then, with the aim of reduction in electrode/epoxy interfacial electric field (E field), relative permittivity inside the insulator was optimized based on Solid Isotropic Microstructures with Penalization (SIMP) method. The simulation results show that the maximum E field reduces from 18.2 kV/mm to 15.2 kV/mm at electrode/epoxy interface, when the optimization area is narrowed down to the vicinity of the inserts and the relative permittivity is set to 12. The results consider the E field and the feasibility of engineering manufacturing together, which provides the constructive suggestion for the design of 252 kV GIS supporting insulator.

articleTitle: Optimization of DC Drop Point for AC-DC Hybrid System with both Safety and Economy
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The selection of DC drop point has a profound impact on the safety and economy of AC-DC system. The selection of appropriate DC drop point can not only improve the system’s ability to resist the risk of commutation failure, but also improve the system’s transmission capacity and reduce network loss. Therefore, the optimization of DC drop point has guiding significance for the safety planning of AC-DC system and the improvement of new energy consumption ability. To this end, this paper first uses two economic indices of Available Transfer Capability (ATC), network loss rate and effective short-circuit ratio safety index to construct a comprehensive evaluation index. Secondly, quantum particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize the selection of DC drop points to improve the accuracy and efficiency of DC drop points selection. Finally, a multi-dimensional optimization evaluation system for DC drop point of AC-DC hybrid system is formed to achieve rapid and accurate evaluation of DC drop point. The modified IEEE39-node system is used for example analysis, and the simulation is compared with the traditional particle swarm optimization algorithm under the same conditions, which verifies the accuracy and rapidity of the proposed method, and provides a reference for the optimal selection of the DC drop point of the AC-DC hybrid delivery system in desert large-scale new energy base.

articleTitle: Bi-Level Electricity Market Clearing Model Considering Cross-Regional Green Energy Transactions
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the development of the green electricity market, the scale of cross-provincial and cross-regional electricity trading is expanding, and the varieties of green electricity trading are gradually increasing. Although the government encourages power users to consume green electricity, the enthusiasm of power users to consume green electricity is not high because the environmental value of green electricity has yet to be discovered. In this paper, a cross-regional bi-level clearing model considering green electricity transactions is established. Through the carbon flow tracing model based on the principle of proportional distribution, the carbon emission factors at the load side are calculated. By comparing the carbon emission factors of users who do not trade green electricity with those who trade green electricity, the environmental value of green electricity is reflected. The electric energy value and environmental value of different medium and long-term green electricity trading varieties are explored. The results show that the consumption of green electricity can significantly reduce the user’s carbon emission factor. Through the comparative analysis of different green electricity trading varieties, it is found that the green electricity variety that can offset the carbon emissions of electricity users at other times can give green electricity users a higher environmental value. It provides a reference for power users to consume green electricity.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Identification Method of Iron Core Jam in High Voltage Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The stable and reliable operation of the high voltage circuit breaker is the key to ensure the safety and stability of the power grid, and the mechanical properties are the basis to ensure the expected electrical performance of the high voltage circuit breaker. As the operation time of circuit breakers becomes longer and longer, the rejection failure caused by the electromagnetic iron jam is frequent, which brings hidden dangers to the safe operation of power grid. To identify the defect of the iron core jam, the mathematical model of the electromagnetic system is established firstly in this paper. On the basis of the model verification, the fault simulation of different iron core jam degree is carried out, and the identification method of iron core jam based on time domain characteristics and its implementation algorithm are proposed. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by practical engineering application.

articleTitle: Identification of Vulnerable Lines in Power Grids Based on Complex Network Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The widespread interconnection of power grids can quickly transmit local faults to a larger scale or even throughout the entire power network. Nowadays, there are many studies on the vulnerability of power grids, but often there is inadequate consideration. Firstly, by integrating existing research and based on complex network theory, this study introduces the weighted line betweenness centrality index for lines. Simultaneously, a method for identifying vulnerable lines in power grids based on weighted line betweenness centrality is proposed, forming a process for identifying vulnerable lines. Finally, taking the IEEE-39 Bus System and 110 kV partial grid in Qinghai as examples, the identified vulnerable lines are subjected to cascade attacks, and the changes in network efficiency are analyzed. The results indicate that the identification of vulnerable lines in power grids can be achieved using the weighted line betweenness centrality index, which is both rational and effective.

articleTitle: The Optimal Control Strategy of Distribution Network Voltage Violation Considering the Cooperative Operation of Photovoltaic and Energy Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With a large number of Distributed Photovoltaics (DPVs) integrated into the grid, there is a problem of daytime overvoltage and low voltage at night in the distribution network, which further affects the economic operation of the network. On this basis, a two-stage optimization operation strategy of DPVs and Energy Storage Systems (ESSs) is proposed in this paper. In the first stage of the strategy, the position and amount of charge and discharge of the ESSs are determined by calculating the voltage sensitivity of the node, as well as the adjustable node of photovoltaic reactive power. Then, the optimization operation model is established in the second stage. The model aims to cost of the distribution network by optimizing the ESS capacity and the reactive power of photovoltaic inverters. The model is calculated by particle swarm optimization, and the daily scheduling output strategy of DPVs and ESSs can be obtained. Finally, using a 19-node actual distribution network as an example, the results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. The simulation results show that the proposed strategy can effectively solve the voltage violation problem through the cooperative dispatching of PVs and ESSs, and achieve the goal of optimizing the operating cost while ensuring the voltage safety of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Identification of Converter Control Parameters for VSG-Type Energy Storage Systems Based on the IDEPSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Addressing the challenges associated with the numerous control parameters and the difficulty of tuning simulation parameters in the VSG-type energy storage system models, this paper introduces a method for identifying control parameters using an Improved Differential Evolution Particle Swarm Optimization (IDEPSO) algorithm. By integrating the real-number coding, simple mutation operations, and a "one-on-one" competitive survival strategy from the Differential Evolution (DE) algorithm into the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm, and adopting a non-fixed gradient inertial weight strategy in PSO along with an elite-preservation approach in the crossover factor of the DE algorithm, the capability for multi-dimensional optimization, convergence speed, and global search ability of the algorithm. Finally, the identified parameters were imported into the VSG-type energy storage system simulation model, and a deviation calculation was performed between the experimental data and simulation data to verify that this set of identified parameters is applicable to multiple working conditions.

articleTitle: Operation Optimization of Integrated Energy System Considering Demand Response and Carbon Trading
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Integrated energy system is a useful tool for achieving the"dual-carbon"goal. In order to explore the demand-side adjustable potential of the comprehensive energy system for lowering carbon emissions, this paper proposes an optimal operation model that accounts for demand response under a carbon trading mechanism. Initially, the demand response is classified into two categories based on the characteristics of the load response. Additionally, a carbon trading mechanism is built for the integrated energy system by allocating the carbon emission quotas for the system using the baseline technique, which is free of charge. The actual carbon emissions from the gas turbine and gas boiler are also taken into account. Ultimately, a low-carbon optimization operation model of the integrated energy system is established, with the goal of minimizing the total cost of energy purchase, carbon trading, and operation and maintenance. The suggested model's validity is then confirmed through four types of typical scenarios.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling Research on Hydrogen Production from Anion Exchange Membrane Electrolysis
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Anion Exchange Membrane (AEM) electrolysis for hydrogen production is a technique that utilizes anion exchange membranes as separators in the electrolytic cell to decompose water into hydrogen gas and oxygen gas. The performance indicators of AEM electrolysis cells mainly include two aspects: electrolysis voltage and hydrogen content in oxygen. This paper establishes mathematical models for electrolysis voltage and hydrogen content in oxygen, and their influencing factors and patterns are analyzed. The research reveals that the electrolysis voltage increases with the increase of anion membrane thickness and cathode pressure, while it decreases with the increase of temperature. The hydrogen content in oxygen decreases with the increase of membrane thickness and increases with the increase of cathode pressure. The research results provide theoretical basis for reducing the energy consumption of AEM electrolysis cells for hydrogen production and improving gas purity.

articleTitle: Flexibility Analysis of Coal-fired Power Plants for Enhancing New Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The rapid development of new energy has increasingly highlighted the need for more flexibility in thermal power industry, making them suitable for new energy consumption. This paper proposes applying two heat-power decoupling technologies: low-pressure turbine zero output scheme and absorption heat pump combined heating technology to captive power plants to deeply tap the peak shaving potential of captive power plants and solve the current and future difficulties of new energy consumption. The former achieves heat-power decoupling by cutting off the steam inlet of the low-pressure turbine. At the same time, the latter recovers the heat of the condenser cooling water to achieve a higher heating load. A comparative evaluation of the two technologies was carried out. When #5 steam extraction was modified, the results show that in terms of maximum heat load increase, scheme one increased by 171 MW, scheme two increased by 164.50 MW, and scheme one showed the most significant increase in heating supply. Regarding the minimum electric load rate, scheme one is 50.86%, and scheme two is 78.00%, with scheme one showing the most significant improvement in the plant’s peak shaving capacity.

articleTitle: A Broadband Impedance On-line Measurement Method for Power Grids and Inverters
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Accurate measurement of grid impedance and inverter impedance is an important part of impedance stability analysis. Measurement using the traditional sweep method cannot measure the impedance of the grid impedance and the inverter impedance accurately and quickly at the same time. To address this problem, this paper proposes an optimized multi-sine perturbation injection method to improve the impedance measurement efficiency, which can measure the inverter impedance and grid impedance accurately at the same time. Finally, a low-voltage broadband impedance measurement platform is built to verify the effectiveness and accuracy of the method.

articleTitle: Study on VFTO Influence of Main Equipment’s Safety Performance in UHV Substation
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In UHV Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) substation, Very Fast Transient Overvoltage (VFTO) may occur during the operation of disconnector. VFTO stresses the GIS itself, turn-to-turn insulation of transformers, and all the secondary equipment connected to GIS as well. This study takes a typical UHV substation as an example, VFTO in the GIS substations UHV transmission Project under the latest layout of equipment are studied. Many representative modes of disconnector operations are simulated, and consequent VFTO stresses on equipment are provided. The configurations of damping resister of disconnector and measure points are recommended in the report, which can be the references for engineering design, equipment bidding and system operation.
