publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Distributed energy has the characteristics of high efficiency and environmental protection, which can improve the stability of the distribution network, but after accessing distributed energy, the distribution network inevitably faces scheduling problems, which increases the energy loss. Therefore, this paper investigates a multi-timescale optimization method for distribution networks based on distributed energy based on three timescales: day-ahead, intra-day and real-time, which in turn improves the utilization of energy in distribution networks and improves the quality of power supply services.

articleTitle: Optimization Strategy of Virtual Power Plant Operation Considering Carbon Trading
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In view of the problems of limited development and unclear profit model of virtual power plant during the exploration of the business model of virtual power plant, this paper establishes a day-before operation optimization model of virtual power plant considering carbon trading under the premise of responding to the constraint of carbon peak, and participates in electricity market and carbon market trading through reasonable scheduling of internal resources. It can make virtual power plant operators obtain stable income to a certain extent. Through simulation experiments, it is proved that virtual power plant can absorb more renewable energy on the premise of satisfying the internal supply and demand balance under the condition of reasonably guiding internal flexible load to participate in the demand response, increase the profit in the carbon market and improve the overall income.

articleTitle: SOC Estimation for Sodium-ion Battery Based on Fusion Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The accurate estimation of State of Charge (SOC) is crucial for ensuring the stable operation of energy storage system. This paper proposed a fusion algorithm for the SOC estimation of sodium-ion battery, which utilizes the ampere-hour integral method in the platform period and open-circuit voltage method with the online parameter identification in other periods. Firstly, the first-order RC Equivalent Circuit Model (ECM) is constructed. Secondly, the Forgetting Factor Recursive Least Squares (FFRLS) method is used to estimate the real-time parameters, which is aimed at mitigating the impact of environmental factors. Next, according to the increasing of the identified U<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ocv</inf> error in the platform period, a fusion estimation algorithm is proposed. Finally, we conduct experiments under DST and FUDS conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm has similar accuracy to UKF and EKF algorithm under DST or FUDS condition. The fusion estimation algorithm is about 32% and 88% faster than EKF and UKF algorithms.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis on High-speed Permanent Magnet Motor Used in Air Compressor of Hydrogen Fuel Cells
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: This paper focused on the analysis technologies of the high-speed permanent magnet synchronous motor used for air compressors in fuel cells, and the operation experiments were carried out. In electromagnetic analysis, the radial and tangential components of magnetic flux density were obtained using the analytical formula for the solid cylindrical permanent magnet. The results were verified through finite element simulation. The electrical performance of the permanent magnet synchronous motor were analyzed, and the results of no-load induced voltage, electromagnetic torque, and power were obtained. The critical speed of the bearing-rotor system was evaluated. There was an appropriate margin between the first-order bending critical speed and the operating speed. The operation experiments on the high-speed permanent magnet synchronous motor were completed at the speed of 70000 rpm. The electrical and dynamic performances of the high-speed permanent magnet synchronous motor were verified.

articleTitle: Robust Coordination Optimal DPFC and Transmission Expansion Planning Considering Uncertainty of Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Carrying out the optimal collaborative planning of Distributed Power Flow Controller (DPFC)and Transmission Expansion Programming (TEP) will improve the robustness and flexibility of network-side regulation, expand the feasible operating range of system scheduling, and improve participation level of network-side collaborative system operation. Based on the power flow regulation characteristics and rapid response capability of DPFC, taking into account the uncertain characteristics of wind power, this paper carries out a study on robust dispatch joint optimization taking into account the collaborative optimization of TEP and DPFC, focusing on the system Dispatch strategy, renewable energy consumption capacity, wind curtailment and load shedding risks, on the basis of retaining the non-linear relationship between the grid-side line planning scheme and the DPFC planning, and simultaneously optimizing the TEP scheme and the location and allocation of multiple DPFCs, improve the economic level of system scheduling, and reduce system load shedding risks. The simulation results show that the proposed strategy is beneficial to significantly improving the renewable energy consumption capacity and system operation economy.

articleTitle: Study on Vibration Noise of Power Transformers Based on Multi-physical Field Simulation and Experiment
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the rapid development of power transmission and transformation in our country, transformer, as an important hub in the process of power transmission and transformation, has attracted much attention. The problem of vibration and noise pollution will occur during the operation of transformers, and it is becoming more and more serious with the continuous improvement of the number, capacity and voltage level of transformers, so the research on the problem of transformer vibration and noise has attracted much attention. In this paper, A 110kV, 63MVA transformer model was built through the finite element simulation platform, and the electromagnetic and mechanical multi-physical field coupling method was adopted to simulate the transformer vibration. In addition, KeyCam2 acoustic imager was used to collect the transformer noise on site, and the simulation and test results were analyzed.

articleTitle: Fault Ride-through Control Strategies for Sparse AC/AC Modular Multilevel Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the increasing global demand for renewable energy, the development and utilization of offshore wind power as an important clean energy source has received great attention. In this paper, we investigate the fault ride-through control strategy of sparse AC/AC modular multilevel converter (SMMC) for the long-distance transmission and grid connection of offshore wind farms. This paper first introduces the topology and control strategy of SMMC, including its internal structure and operation principle. Then, the power change of the wind farm under fault scenarios is simulated and the system transient characteristics are analyzed by the voltage source converter (VSC) model of an equivalent wind farm. On this basis, a fault ride-through control scheme for SMMC is proposed, i.e., to regulate the low-frequency side voltage and the wind farm output power to maintain the system stability and prevent the converter from being removed when a fault occurs in the grid on the fundamental frequency side. The effectiveness of the proposed fault ride-through strategy is verified by a simulation model built on the MATLAB/Simulink platform. The simulation results show that after adopting the fault ride-through strategy, the SMMC system is capable of operating smoothly without disconnecting from the grid during the specified fault time, effectively reducing the fluctuation of the sub-module capacitance-voltage and returning to the normal operating state after the fault is removed.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Distributed Collaborative Control Strategy for New Energy Power Stations Considering Communication Interruption
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: New energy generation base located in regions characterized by desertification and arid landscapes seeing rapid growth in the number of wind and photovoltaic power stations. Each individual power stations are geographically dispersed and possess a significant power generation capacity. These stations require communication networks to engage in frequency regulation. However, in the desertified and wasteland regions, which is remote and faces tough natural conditions like sandstorms and extreme temperature changes, communication disruptions are inevitable. This affects the system’s ability to stay stable and reliable. This paper proposes hierarchical distributed coordinated control strategy for new energy power stations to participate in frequency regulation collectively according to their generation capacity ratios. Based on hierarchical distributed control principles, mathematical models and control algorithms are designed for these renewable generation stations to bolster power system frequency stability. Meanwhile, a data prediction and compensation mechanism is introduced to provide supplementary data in the case of communication interruptions, ensuring continued stable operation of each station. Simulation results are reported to verify the validity and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Series Multiple Diode Rectifiers Based HVDC Link for Deep-sea Offshore Wind Farms
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel HVDC link based on series multiple diode rectifiers (SMDRs) specifically tailored for deep-sea offshore wind farms (OWFs). The topology of SMDRs using multi-windings phase shifting transformer (PST) is designed and the operation scheme for SMDR-OWF is introduced. Compared to regular OWF topologies, proposed SMDR-OWF exhibits superior performance on low-cost and lightweight for DR’s own advantages and its possibility to leave off quantities of passive power filters (PPFs). Simulations are conducted to verify the steady-state operation of SMDR-OWF, while comparative validations confirm its capable of reliably operating with extremely low harmonics and reactive power even in the absence of filter devices.

articleTitle: Exploring New User-Point Voltage Control Demand Side Management for Supporting Frequency Responses of Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The paper presents a User-Point Voltage Controller (UPVC) mechanism for achieving Demand Side Management (DSM) in microgrids. The UPVC is realized via a tapped auto-transformer technology with embedded communication units for microgrid coordinating control. The transformer tap position changes will lead to user's voltage variations, then resulting in load variations. The aggregated load changes across the microgrid will help achieve balance between the demand and generation. Due to multiple transformer tap structures, each participating load will only experience small step voltage changes, which is almost unnoticeable. A generalized power-voltage difference calculation algorithm is proposed in the paper to interpret the power gap between the generation and demand into individual user point voltage change requirement. The feasibility of the algorithm is tested and compared with Voltage Control at Substation (VCS) through simulation study of four distinct scenarios using a model microgrid.

articleTitle: Stabilization of Cascaded Power Converters Using Enhanced Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Due to the rapid development of renewable energy technologies, energy storage technologies have also been extensively investigated. Recently, cascaded power converters have gained great attention for developing energy storage systems. In this paper, the instability issue of voltage source converters driving constant power loads is investigated. Based on the Nyquist criterion, the instability can be explained in the impedance model. A few examples are given to illustrate this kind of instability. The key to avoiding instability is to decrease the output impedance of the source converter, which can be done by Model Predictive Control (MPC). An enhanced model predictive control with impedance compensation, is proposed in this paper to avoid instability. A DC system example and an AC system example are given to verify the proposed method.

articleTitle: Power Allocation Control Strategy for Hydrogen-Electric Hybrid Energy Storage System Based on Type-2 Fuzzy Logic Control
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The introduction of hydrogen energy storage into DC microgrid has become an effective way to smooth the energy fluctuations caused by renewable energy. However, the collaborative operation control of hydrogen energy storage and traditional battery energy storage is still full of challenges in practical application. Therefore, the external characteristics model of Hydrogen Energy Storage System based on water and gas multiphase flow balance is established, and the hydrogen-electrochemical Hybrid Energy Storage (H-EHES) DC micro-grid system is constructed. On this basis, according to the State of Charge (SOC) of the battery and hydrogen storage tank, a power allocation strategy based on Type-2 Fuzzy Logic Control (T2-FLC) is proposed to realize the reasonable distribution of excess energy in the system and timely supplement the power difference caused by the lack of renewable energy capacity, and strengthen the complementary mechanism between different energy storage media. It prolongs the service life of the energy storage system and ensures the stable and efficient operation of the hybrid energy storage system.

articleTitle: Recovery Strategy of Electricity-Gas Integrated Energy System Considering Load Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The influence of load participating in demand response on IPGDS is analyzed. Firstly, the demand response model of electricity, gas and IPGDS comprehensive load is established, and the unit capacity compensation cost model of corresponding load is proposed. Secondly, considering the participation of load demand response, a bi-level optimization model of IPGDS energy supply recovery is established. The upper optimization obtains the partition scheme of the system, the lower optimization obtains the load recovery scheme of each partition, and the energy supply recovery scheme of IPGDS is obtained through the upper and lower iterations. Finally, the effectiveness of the coordinated optimization decision-making method proposed in this chapter is verified by an example.

articleTitle: Improved Presynchronization Control Method Based on Phase-angle Difference Jump Elimination
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The pre-synchronization strategy based on phase angle difference control can inhibit the control of pre-synchronization due to the periodic jumps in phase angle difference, which can lead to system instability in severe cases. Thus, an improved presynchronization control method based on phase angle jump elimination is proposed. Firstly, based on the generation principle of phase angle difference jumps, its negative impact on the VSG presynchronization control process is revealed; after that, the phase angle difference between the VSG output voltage and the grid voltage phase angle during the jumps is analyzed for the reasons of phase angle jumps generated by VSG presynchronization and the new phase angle difference expression is calculated, and then the calculated new phase angle difference is applied to the VSG presynchronization control after the adjustment of the PI control. Then the calculated new phase angle difference is adjusted by PI control and applied to the VSG presynchronization control. Finally, MATLAB/Simulink simulation is utilized to verify the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Enhancing Data Consistency in Distribution Networks Leveraging Graph Contrastive Representation Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The rapid integration of distributed renewable energy sources and the diversification of loads have precipitated profound changes in the configuration and operation of power distribution networks in the 21st century, underscoring the necessity for accurate and standardized power grid topology model data. This manuscript introduces a novel graph contrastive learning-based approach for the representation of node features in distribution networks, specifically targeting the alignment of identical nodes across different Common Information Model (CIM) documents. By combining self-supervised learning with graph neural networks, a feature extraction framework that integrates topological structural features and attribute features of the distribution network is proposed in the paper. Besides, the study designs a graph view generation strategy considering distribution network characteristics. The proposed method is validated by an 11-feeder distribution network dataset, and the results show the effectivity of the graph contrastive learning.

articleTitle: A New Kind of Manhole Door Mechanism for Electrostatic Precipitators
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The manhole door mechanism of an electrostatic precipitator is crucial for its normal operation. However, the commonly manhole door mechanism in current electrostatic precipitators has problems such as poor insulation and sealing performance, easy corrosion of the shell and equipment around the manhole, leading to decrease dust removal efficiency of the electrostatic precipitator. In order to solve the above problems, this article introduces a new type of manhole door mechanism for electrostatic precipitators. Due to the unique cylindrical base and cylindrical sleeve used in the manhole door mechanism, both of which are double-layer structures, filled with insulation materials inside, and reinforced with flange with sealing gaskets. The manhole door mechanism can effectively solve the problems of poor thermal insulation, poor sealing performance, and easy corrosion of equipment in current electrostatic precipitators. The practice has also proven it. Therefore, the new type of electrostatic precipitator manhole mechanism disclosed in this article has high promotion and application value.

articleTitle: Optimization of Energy Storage Configuration for Remote-end Grids Considering Inertia Response
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The power system faces challenges due to the widespread integration of Renewable Energy Sources (RES), resulting in decreased system robustness and increased vulnerability to disturbances, particularly in remote grids. To address these challenges, this paper uses energy storage system to offer virtual inertia support to the grid. An optimization model for energy storage capacity and power configuration in remote grid areas with high RES proportions is proposed. Firstly, a two-stage robust optimization model is established, with an energy storage time series scheduling framework that considers grid inertia support requirements and uncertainties associated with wind power, photovoltaics, and load power. Secondly, the column-and-constraints generation algorithm is employed to satisfy system inertia support requirements while maximizing economic efficiency. Through a case study focusing on the inertia support requirements of a specific remote-end grid, the effectiveness of the proposed strategy is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Research on Power System Fault Diagnosis Based on Fault Tolerance
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In power system fault diagnosis engineering, uncertainty of line protection and circuit breaker is an important factor affecting fault diagnosis. To this end, through the BFT (Byzantine Fault Tolerance) voting method, the faulty equipment and the fault type are judged by using the state matrix between the equipment in the system. After collecting real time data with the PMU, the PDC sends the expected state matrix after line failure to the system-wide measurement equipment. Protection devices, circuit breakers, alarms will logically compare the actual state with the expected matrix and vote for recognized faulty devices within the protection domain. This method takes into account the uncertainty of the power system and has relatively reliable fault tolerance.

articleTitle: Coordinated Optimal Control Strategy of Multiple Frequency Regulation Resource
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Currently, the provincial and local power grids are facing increasing pressure of frequency regulation and peak load management. This paper analyzes the coordinated optimal control strategy of provincial and local power grids with the participation of multiple regulating resources. An optimization model for the provincial and local two-level grids is constructed considering the characteristics of thermal power units, energy storage systems, wind power, photovoltaics, hydropower and other new energy sources. Then the coordinated automatic generation control scheme based on opportunity constraints is designed for the provincial and local grids. Finally, the proposed strategy is tested on the provincial and local grids. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed strategy effectively regulates the frequency fluctuation at the provincial and local levels under the uncertainty of wind power.

articleTitle: Low Complexity Data-Driven Load Frequency Control for the Power System with Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Integrating wind power into existing power systems presents challenges related to uncertainty and communication failures. These factors significantly impact the accuracy of power system modeling. Specifically, the conventional Load Frequency Control (LFC) scheme, designed with an inappropriate model, compromises the stability of frequency regulation. To address this issue, our paper proposes a novel data-driven LFC design method based on a behavioral approach. Unlike existing data-driven methods that rely on multi-agent reinforcement learning, our approach utilizes a finite dataset and maintains low complexity. Under the persistent excitation assumption of the dataset, we directly derive an explicit feedback gain from the dataset by solving an LMI (Linear Matrix Inequality) optimization problem. As a result, our data-driven method provides more explicit results than the reinforcement learning approach, making it safer for engineering power systems. We validate the proposed LFC scheme through simulation results across different scales of power systems.

articleTitle: Reliability Assessment for Wind Turbine under Index Weight and Failure of Subsystem
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Wind turbine is a multi-system highly integrated complex facilities, once a subsystem fails, the wind turbine will stop running, and the influence of evaluation index to reliability on each subsystem to wind turbine have large differences. It is an urgent problem that to analyze the reliability that subsystem impact on the wind turbine. Considering the weight and model to analyze evaluation index and failure on the influence of reliability. For obtaining the reliability index weight, using Analysis Hierarchical Process (AHP) to divide layers of the wind turbine, influencing factors and subsystems, and the three scales method indicates the degree of influence on the reliability evaluation index of each layer under AGREE method, the reliability weights of each subsystem to the wind turbine are acquired by calculating judgement matrix. Based on the failure data of subsystems, considering the probability that a non-halting failure becomes halting failure on the influence of reliability, and model on Weibull distribution is proposed. Finally, analyzing the influence of subsystems in series system on wind turbine, assessment is based on the reliability weights and model against the subsystems.

articleTitle: Power Grid Security Risk Assessment for Online Restoration Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In online restoration decision-making, online security and stability analysis and risk assessment of restored power grid and restoration plan are important technical means to ensure the safe and reliable recovery of the power grid, but there is still a lack of reasonable evaluation methods. Therefore, in this paper, firstly, a characteristic index system of Power Grid in Restoration (PGR) is proposed, which conforms to the characteristics of the whole recovery process, and a corresponding fault set of online security and stability analysis is generated for each characteristic, and evaluation functions are determined. Then, an online security risk assessment method of PGR and recovery plan based on Monte Carlo simulation is further put forward. The effectiveness of this method is verified by the analysis of an example.

articleTitle: Thermal Impact of Bridge Arm Reactors on Indoor Metallic Components
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The dry hollow bridge arm reactor is a key component in transmission converter stations. It is capable of controlling the power transmission of the converter and suppressing current fluctuations. However, the reactor arm has severe magnetic leakage, leading to inevitable heating of surrounding metallic structural components in alternating magnetic fields. This poses potential risks to the lifespan of steel structures and personnel safety. Currently, research on the heating of surrounding metallic structural components due to the reactor mainly focuses on H-shaped steel structures. In this paper, a magnetic-thermal simulation model for indoor bridge arm reactor and surrounding metallic structural components was established for various metallic structural components surrounding the 24mH bridge arm reactor in a 700MW substation. Using the magnetic-thermal field coupling module of the TR-Sim multi-physics calculation software, the influence of the spacing between various metallic structural components and the bridge arm reactor on the temperature rise of corresponding metallic structural components during normal operation was calculated. The shortest distance to ensure the long-term safe and reliable operation of steel structures and personnel safety was determined, providing guidance for the layout of bridge arm reactors in practical engineering applications.

articleTitle: A Multi-dimensional Classification Aggregation Method of County Characteristic Load Based on Different Load Demand
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: County energy is an important part of China ’s energy system and plays an irreplaceable role. Scientific and rational utilization and consumption of county energy plays an important role in improving the economic and reliable operation of power system and improving the quality of power supply. Due to the wide distribution of county-level characteristic load space and the weak structure of distribution network, the existing methods are still difficult to balance the selection of clustering number and initial clustering center, and are prone to local optimal results. In this paper, the optimal clustering number and initial distribution are obtained by pre-aggregation based on split-coupling improved K-means, and the idea of simulated annealing algorithm is used to improve the global optimal solution of ant colony clustering search, effectively improve the aggregation accuracy and efficiency, and accurately establish county characteristic load aggregation.

articleTitle: Design of Wide-Band Impedance Measurement Device for Distribution Network and Its Control Method
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The impedance-based method is an important method for studying the wide-band oscillation problem caused by the high proportion of renewable energy connected to the distribution network. In order to measure the frequency domain impedance characteristics of renewable energy generation equipment in the distribution network, a wide-band impedance measurement device design and control method are proposed. The measuring frequency is from 10Hz to 2kHz. This article first introduces the overall design scheme of the proposed impedance measurement device. Then, the design of each part of the voltage disturbance injection unit is mainly analyzed. Corresponding control methods are proposed for AC/DC modules and H-bridge circuits in the voltage perturbation injection unit. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed impedance measurement device design and control method is verified through experiments.

articleTitle: Research on the Development Process of Surface Discharge Defects of Oil-paper Insulation Structures
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The characteristics of the development process of discharge defects in oil-paper insulation structures can be used to provide early warning for internal arc breakdown fault in oil immersed equipment. The paper conducts series of experiment to study the development process of surface discharge defects in oilpaper insulation structures. It is found that the entire discharge development process can be divided into partial discharge stage, spark discharge stage, intermittent surface flashover stage, and arc breakdown stage. The discharge quantity and discharge frequency will fluctuate and increase with the development of discharge defects, and the initial phase of discharge pulses will show a downward trend. In addition, the paper also explains the mechanism of discharge development from the perspective of equivalent circuits.

articleTitle: Virtual Flux Observer-based Power Decoupling Virtual Impedance Method for VSG
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) can provide inertia for the new-type power system. Although the VSG mimics the conventional synchronous generator, the coupling of active power and reactive power may reduce the control effect of the VSG. This paper analyzes the steady-state output power first, and the virtual resistance method is used to reduce the steady-state power coupling. Then, the small-signal model is analyzed, based on the model, and the adaptive virtual impedance method is proposed to further decouple the power. However, the virtual impedance requires the evaluation of the grid phase, therefore, the virtual flux observer is used to estimate the phase. The proposed method can improve the output power quality without changing the VSG’s parameters or characteristics. Finally, the simulation contains the conventional virtual impedance method the proposed method is conducted, and the effectiveness of the proposed observer-based power decoupling strategy is validated.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Renewable Energy Generators on Single-phase Gound Fault Location in Collection Line
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The traditional power grid system changes continuously because the renewable energy generators’ connection, which also brings various influences on fault location in distribution networks. This paper proposes a method of the single-phase ground fault location based on parameter identification. It establishes a fault location equation based on the zero-sequence equivalent circuit model, and takes the fault distance as an unknown quantity for parameter identification and solution. In order to clarify the influences on fault location caused by the connection of renewable energy generators to the grid, the characteristics of single-phase ground faults are analyzed; the impact on the changes of distribution network voltage, current and other electrical parameters is investigated; and then the fault location equation is modified. The simulation results show that the proposed method based on parameter identification has high precision, and the additional voltage and current components will be injected into the fault point after the connection of renewable energy generators, which affects the accuracy of the fault location results.

articleTitle: Research on Standards for Grid-Connected Power Regulation of Photovoltaic Power Stations in China
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the continuous increase in the proportion of installed Photovoltaic (PV) power stations (PVPS) in China, the qualification rate of PVPS participating in the rapid power regulation of the power grid will become increasingly important for the safe and stable operation of the power grid. In order to ensure the safe and stable operation of the power system and the safety of PVPS grid connection, it is urgent to summarize various standards and requirements related to PVPS grid connection power regulation. This article conducts research and analysis on existing national standards, industry standards, and State Grid Corporation standards in China, including grid adaptability and safety protection, active power climbing speed, inertia response, primary frequency regulation, AGC control, reactive power capacity configuration, reactive power support during voltage ride through, primary voltage regulation, and AVC control. The index requirements for grid connected power regulation related testing of PVPS are extracted, which can provide reference for the testing indicators required for rapid power regulation testing of PVPS in China in the future.

articleTitle: Evaluation Methods for the Strategic Value of Power Grid Companies
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the increasing global demand for energy and the advancement of energy transition, the role of power grid companies in ensuring energy supply security, supporting economic development, and addressing environmental challenges is becoming increasingly important. In this context, this paper proposes a method for assessing the strategic value of power grid companies. Starting with the definition of strategic value, a strategic value evaluation system for power grid companies is constructed. The entropy-weighted grey relational assignment and cloud model evaluation methods are proposed to assess the strategic value evaluation system. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is validated through a case study analysis based on the customer satisfaction dimension of a domestic power grid company. The research results provide important support for power grid companies to optimize strategic decision-making and help ensure that their operational activities better align with the long-term development goals of society and the environment.

articleTitle: Digital and Intelligent Transformation of Power Transmission and Transformation Projects: Theoretical Framework, Key Technologies and Research Prospects
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Digital and intelligent transformation is the key to the high-quality development of power transmission and transformation projects, and also an urgent need to promote the construction of a new power system given the goal of "carbon peaking and carbon neutrality". This paper discusses the theoretical framework, key technologies, and research prospects of digital and intelligent transformation of power transmission and transformation projects. Firstly, a theoretical framework based on the I-P-O model and the TOE framework is proposed, with the key technical and management factors included in the framework in a matrix structure, which provides a clear perspective for analyzing the digital and intelligent transformation of power transmission and transformation projects. The framework takes digital twins, smart construction sites, collaborative design platforms, industrial ecosystems, etc. as the core of the transformation. Then, this paper elaborates on three technologies, multi-source data fusion, model light-weighting, and 5D construction, which are the key technologies that currently restrict the further development of digital and intelligent transformation of power transmission and transformation projects, and play a vital role in improving the construction and management of power transmission and transformation projects. Finally, this paper puts forward research prospects for the digital and intelligent transformation of power transmission and transformation projects from the perspectives of engineering construction capacity, lean construction, and forecasting and early-warning capability in complex environments.

articleTitle: Ultra-Short-Term Forecasting of Electric Vehicle Charging Load Based on Transformer Architecture integrated with Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: To address the issue of low prediction accuracy for electric vehicle charging load influenced by multiple factors such as weather and holidays, we propose an ultra-short-term forecasting model for electric vehicle charging load based on the Transformer architecture integrated with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), termed TransLSTM. Initially, the inherent self-attention mechanism of the Transformer is employed to deeply capture intricate relationships between various dimensional input features, including load and meteorological data, extracting contextual information from all positions and aggregating this into a hidden state passed to the LSTM unit. Subsequently, within the LSTM unit, this aggregated hidden state and the original input features are jointly processed to deeply unearth the global dependencies of the time-series data. The load prediction is finally output through a linear layer, establishing a prediction model that's highly sensitive to time series nuances and possesses profound multidimensional feature extraction capabilities. Simulation experiments were carried out using an electric vehicle charging load dataset from certain areas in London, UK, and concurrent NWP datasets. Results indicate that, compared to conventional models, the proposed model in this paper has enhanced capability to capture features of time-series data. Moreover, when considering various factors affecting electric vehicle charging, its performance stability is notably superior, achieving higher prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Development and Verification of Digital Real-Time Hardware-in-the-Loop Co-simulation Platform Based on PSS/E and RTDS
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Electromechanical-electromagnetic co-simulation combines the fast simulation speed of electromechanical transient procedure with the high accuracy of electromagnetic transient procedure for DC and other power electronic equipment. This approach is ideal for simulating and analyzing new power systems that feature a high proportion of new energy sources and power electronic equipment. This paper presents a digital real-time hardware-in-the-loop hybrid simulation platform constructed using PSS/E and RTDS. The dynamic model of PSS/E is improved to achieve ultra-real-time simulation, and data communication between PSS/E and RTDS is achieved through the shared memory function. The hybrid AC/DC grid example of multi-computer is tested on the hardware-in-the-loop test, combined with the actual control and protection system of DC voltage-DC transmission. Hardware-in-the-loop testing was conducted and the results were compared and analysed with the full electromagnetic simulation results. The analysis showed that the digital real-time hardware-in-the-loop hybrid simulation of PSS/E-RTDS is highly suitable for the analysis of 'double-high' power systems.

articleTitle: An Lz-Transform-based Model for Short-Term Reliability Assessment of Photovoltaic Power Generation Systems Considering Meteorological Uncertainty and System Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Considering meteorological uncertainty and component failure, a multi-state model of Photovoltaic (PV) power generation system is established to evaluate the reliability of power generation systems. Specifically, the attenuation of solar radiation is quantified under different meteorological conditions using the clearness index, and a PV output uncertainty model is developed based on the Markov model. Next, considering the component series-parallel relationships within the system structure, a fault model of the PV power generation system is developed based on the Lz-transform method and series-parallel operators. Therefore, a multi-state reliability model of PV power generation systems is proposed, where both meteorological uncertainty and PV topology structure are considered comprehensively. Stimulation results demonstrate that the proposed model is validated.

articleTitle: Analysis and Suppression in Subsynchronous Oscillation of Doubly-Fed Wind Farm through Series Compensation Grid-Connected System
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Wind energy has been vigorously developed as a clean energy and has become an important part of the national energy strategy. However, as the doubly-fed wind farms increases, its problems become more and more prominent. In the event of a grid fault or an asymmetric fault, the power flow between the Rotor Side Converter (RSC) and the Grid Side Converter (GSC) may cause subsynchronous oscillation, resulting in system stability. This paper aims to study the subsynchronous oscillation problem and suppression methods of wind farms. Firstly, a system model of doubly-fed wind turbines connected to the grid through series compensation was established based on mathematical equations. Next, based on the eigenvalue method, the effects of wind speed, series compensation degree and RSC inner current loop proportional on the subsynchronous oscillation mode were analyzed. Finally, a measure based on Static Var Compensator (SVC) is proposed to suppress subsynchronous oscillations, the mechanism of SVC suppressing subsynchronous oscillations is analyzed, also an SVC damping control strategy is designed, and its rationality is verified through time-domain simulation.

articleTitle: Multi-stage Robust Planning Method for Park-Level Integrated Energy System Considering Evolution of Investment Costs and Carbon Emissions
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: To promote the progress of carbon dioxide peaking and carbon neutrality, the Park-level Integrated Energy System (PIES) has attracted widespread attention since it can effectively improve the energy utilization efficiency and consumption of renewable energy sources. To achieve an economical and environmentally friendly supply of multiple energy with low carbon emissions, this paper proposed a multi-stage robust planning method considering the evolution of investment costs and carbon emissions. Accommodating the evolution of unit investment costs and changes in load levels during the long term, the planning horizon is divided into several stages and a set of devices is invested at the beginning of each stage. Moreover, uncertainty sets are utilized to model the fluctuation of PV output, electric load, and heat load during the short term. On this basis, a robust optimization model is constructed, where the objective is to minimize the total investment cost, operating cost and carbon emission cost. A Column-and-Constraint Generation (C&CG) algorithm is developed to solve the multi-stage robust planning model. Finally, a case study is conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. Simulation results demonstrate that the method yields an economical and low-carbon planning scheme while remaining robust against multiple uncertainties.

articleTitle: Design, Simulation, and Analysis of the Performance of IceWind Turbine as a Supplement to Power Demands in Villa Iowa, Canlaon City
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: This study focused on a type of Vertical Axis Wind Turbine (VAWT), known as the IceWind Turbine, with a Savonius blade design. The main objective of this study is to design, simulate, and analyze the performance of IceWind turbines, mechanical power, and power efficiency and evaluate the results to determine the optimal design with the highest efficiency that will contribute to reducing the power deficiency that is currently occurring in Villa Iowa, Canlaon city. After setting the wind turbine parameters with varying blade radii of 100, 50, and 25 mm, the researchers used Fusion360 to create the 3D model of the three designs and used ANSYS Fluent for the simulation to obtain the necessary parameters of the study, mechanical power, and power output per wind turbine. For the mechanical power, the blade radius parameters of R100 and R25 had the highest and lowest readings of 67.92 Watts and 63.20 Watts, respectively, at a wind velocity of 5 m/s before impact. For the power efficiency, the blade radii parameter of R50 had the highest and lowest readings of 57.08% and 50.03%, respectively, at 4 m/s and 5 m/s of wind velocity before impact.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Evaluation Method for Relay Protection Devices Considering Loss Aversion Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Loss aversion exists typically in evaluations, where an equivalent loss produces greater psychological utility than a gain, making decision makers more focused on taking action to avoid the loss. For the comprehensive evaluation of relay protection devices, it is manifested that experts believe that the performance indicators of relay protection devices reflect different degrees of performance improvement when the amount of change is the same at different points, which leads to the inaccurate results of the evaluation indexes' assignment, and even leads to the distortion of the evaluation. Aiming at the above problems, this paper improves the assignment method based on expert scoring and proposes a comprehensive evaluation method for relay protection devices considering loss aversion features. Firstly, the loss aversion characteristics in the comprehensive evaluation of relay protection devices are analyzed and a loss aversion value utility function applicable to relay protection devices is determined; Secondly, the rationality of expert scores is enhanced by the double entropy value correction G1 method, and the evaluation index assignment method with comprehensive consideration of subjectivity and objectivity is established; Further, an improved comprehensive evaluation method for relay protection devices considering loss aversion and the differences in expert empowerment is proposed; finally, an arithmetic example analysis is carried out based on actual data.

articleTitle: Methodology for Virtual Power Plant Capacity Configuration of Wind-Photovoltaic-Hot Dry Rock-Carnot Battery
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Commercial Virtual Power Plant (CVPP) systems can reduce the intermittency of renewable energy sources, but the low flexibility of CVPPs and the insufficiency of conventional energy storage still hinder the large-scale application of CVPPs. On the other hand, cost is the main factor affecting the development of hot dry rock power plants in Qinghai Province. Therefore, this paper proposes a novel virtual power plant structure based on hot dry rock and Carnot batteries because a virtual power plant with hot dry rock and Carnot batteries can realize high flexibility. Then, based on the credible capacity constraint, a capacity allocation method for a novel wind-hot dry rock-Carnot battery virtual power plant is proposed. The benefits of different renewable energy power plants participating in the virtual power plant are analyzed through examples. The results show that the virtual power plant with hot dry rock and Carnot batteries can increase system revenues. The revenue enhancement of the hot dry rock power plant in the four scenarios is about 10 percent, smoothing the output power fluctuation of renewable energy power plants and providing a new idea for constructing a hot dry rock power plant in Qinghai Province.

articleTitle: Self-response Cooperative Control of Synchronous Condenser and SVC Based on DC Commutation Failure
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: UHVDC (Ultra high voltage direct current) transmission is an important way for large-scale new energy to be sent out for long-distance consumption. However, UHVDC commutation failure is the most common fault, when the fault occurs, it will cause the transient voltage of the AC (alternating current) bus at the DC (direct current) sending end converter station to change drastically, which greatly restricts the level of new energy DC transmission and consumption. Although the DC sending end rectifier station is equipped with a certain capacity of synchronous condenser and SVC (Static Var Compensator), the control of transient voltage still cannot reach the ideal effect. Therefore, this reference proposes a cooperative control method of the synchronous condenser and SVC to cope with the transient overvoltage. Firstly, an analysis was conducted on the transient overvoltage on the AC bus of the sending rectifier station caused by the failure of ultra-high voltage DC commutation, and the mechanism of self-response synergistic control of synchronous condenser and SVC to cope with the transient overvoltage is explained; based on this, the self-response synergistic threshold of synchronous condenser and SVC to cope with the transient overvoltage is set, and the self-response synergistic control of synchronous condenser and SVC to cope with the failure of DC commutation failure is proposed. Finally, the effectiveness of the control method proposed in this reference was verified through simulation.

Author Keywords: Ultra high voltage direct current transmission

articleTitle: Distribution Network Economic Dispatch Based on Network Reconfiguration and Power-heat Combined Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the continuous growth of multi-type loads such as electric heating in the power grid, traditional single scheduled means such as electric load demand response or network reconstruction cannot meet the demand of safe and economic operation of the distribution network. A reliable economic dispatching method for distribution network with the combined demand response of end users is proposed. The method constructs an electric load demand response model that takes into account the user's response capability and satisfaction, a model of the output of different components in the electric-heat coupling system, a distribution network security and economic dispatch model that integrates network reconfiguration and electric-heat combined demand response for multiple time periods, and proposes a heat load demand response strategy based on peak and valley tariffs; the method utilizes the existing resources of the system, effectively avoids complex grid capacity construction, and can greatly reduce the investment costs, and has large economic benefits.

articleTitle: A Method for Distributed Photovoltaic-Storage Cluster Partition with the Goal of Improving Cluster Regulation Potential
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the large-scale integration of Distributed Photovoltaics (DPV), the distribution network will face more problems such as voltage exceeding limits and power backflow across voltage levels, which have a great impact on the operation of the distribution network. This type of problem is more prominent under the operating conditions of long lines and light loads in the distribution network in northwest China. In order to enhance the regulation ability of the distribution network when the voltage exceeds the limit in this situation, this paper proposes a distributed photovoltaic-storage cluster partition method with the goal of improving Cluster Regulation Potential (CRP). Firstly, taking into account the impact of cluster power scheduling, define a CRP index based on optimal energy storage regulation and its calculation method. On this basis, an improved comprehensive performance index is proposed as the basis for cluster partition by combining the CRP index with the modularity index. Then, using the improved K-means clustering algorithm as the partition algorithm, the selection of initial clustering centers is optimized and the clustering results are obtained. Finally, the effectiveness and rationality of the proposed method were verified through simulation using the IEEE33 node system as an example.

articleTitle: Impact of Energy Storage Participation in the Spot Market on Available Transmission Capacity on Interregional Lines
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The Available Transmission Capacity (ATC) of the line is an important indicator for the grid dispatch component to develop an offer strategy. How to consider the impact of energy storage trading on ATC in real power systems is a difficult issue that needs to be addressed today. In this paper, the non-sequential Monte Carlo method is introduced to simulate the operating state of the power system, and the system components are modeled and analyzed and introduce the concept of system risk indicator to sequence the faults of the system in order to improve the calculation speed of the system ATC, and then we establish an economic dispatch model of energy storage participating in the spot market taking into account the cost-benefit, and finally we establish a model of ATC calculation taking into account the spot transaction and verify the validity of the model on the IEEE39 node system. The effectiveness of the model is verified on the IEEE39 node system.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of the Evaluation Index System of Planning Scheme Based on the Unified Planning Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Power grid planning and the safe, stable and efficient operation of the entire power system has a close relationship. How to formulate a scientific and reasonable planning scheme and reasonable arrangement of power grid construction is the focus of the current work. Based on the Unified Planning Platform, this paper studies the construction and application of the evaluation system of economic and technical indicators of planning schemes. Firstly, the evaluation framework of the hierarchical index system was designed, and reasonable indicators were put forward from the perspectives of technology, economy, environmental protection and other levels. Secondly, based on the Unified Planning Platform, the data interface is designed to realize the comprehensive evaluation of power supply projects and power grid projects respectively. Finally, the evaluation index of the planning scheme is designed to display results and push process in a centralized manner, so as to realize the full-scene and multi-perspective evaluation of the planning scheme and ensure the scientific and reasonable development of the power grid.

articleTitle: Optimization Model for Collaborative Control of Energy Flow and Carbon Flow in Industrial Parks
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to promote multi energy complementarity and build low-carbon parks, a carbon emission control model that considers the cooperation between waste incineration power plants and sewage treatment plants is established in this paper. In response to the large amount of carbon dioxide generated during the incineration process of power plants and the treatment process of sewage treatment plants, effective recovery of carbon dioxide is achieved through flue gas treatment, electricity to gas conversion, and biogas purification, while generating natural gas. By utilizing carbon trading mechanisms, load shifting can be achieved through joint control of electricity to gas conversion, flue gas treatment, biogas purification energy consumption, and other controllable loads, thereby stabilizing fluctuations in new energy. Considering the carbon trading mechanism, an optimization control model with the goal of minimizing carbon trading costs was constructed. Based on the CPLEX solver, multiple scenarios were simulated and analyzed for comparison, proving that the proposed model can effectively reduce carbon emissions and has a certain promoting effect on the construction of low-carbon parks.

articleTitle: Lithium-Ion Battery Storage Dispatch with Embedded Analytical Cycle Aging Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Battery aging is a major hindrance to the advancement of batteries, particularly in their use for deep peaking and auxiliary services in the electricity market. Although existing literature recognizes battery aging in dispatch scenarios, the analysis of aging mechanisms often depends on statistical methods such as the rainflow algorithm, which may result in empirical formulas that do not fully consider the complex coupling mechanisms involved in battery aging. In this paper, we innovatively propose a lithium-ion battery(LIB) storage dispatch model with embedded cycle aging mechanism: Firstly, the essay delves into three primary side reactions responsible for battery degradation: solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) film formation and thickening, lithium precipitation, and active particle cracking. Following this exploration, this paper delineates the impacts of these three side-reaction rates on the electrochemical model parameters. Thirdly, a pioneering model is introduced, which integrates side-reaction rates and furnishes analytical expressions for the non-uniform distributions of primary and side-reaction rates. In conclusion, the battery aging model was employed in simulations to engage in power market arbitrage, enabling a comprehensive study of the battery’s aging pattern over the course of a year.

articleTitle: Research on Market Scale of China’s Green Electricity-Carbon Trading Synergistic Service
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The coupled development of green electricity and carbon markets has expanded the scope of emerging service businesses, creating a blue ocean market. With the continuous deepening of green electricity and carbon market construction, the number of participants in each market is increasing. The participants in the green electricity and carbon market trading markets are becoming increasingly diverse and are participating more fully in transactions. This study adopts an analytical model consisting of three modules. The macro-environment analysis module clearly defines the external conditions that affect business development. Market research and analysis module investigates the current status of the industry, studies development trends and determines key parameters. Simulation and forecasting modules to set market forecast scenarios. The research results show that: The emerging carbon business has been developing slowly in the past 10 years, which is the introduction stage of the life cycle theory. It is currently entering a rapid development stage. The proportion of carbon trading agency and green electricity trading agency services has gradually increased, reaching more than 55%. The emerging carbon market size is expected to reach 7-8 billion RMB by 2030 and 11 billion RMB by 2035.

articleTitle: Power Transformer Fault Diagnosis Considering Data Imbalance Based on Counterfactual Graph Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Improving the accuracy of transformer dissolved gas analysis plays a vital role in electric power systems. Due to the scarcity of high-quality fault data, prevailing methods for diagnosing power transformer faults rely on a copious amount of health data, which considerably exceeds the quantity of fault data, in an effort to enhance diagnostic accuracy. However, this approach encounters a significant challenge due to the highly imbalanced nature of the data (i.e., a predominant proportion of health data), which causes minimal variation in the gradient of classifiers during the training phase under conventional loss functions. Simply, the classifier only needs to predict health to achieve high accuracy rates. In this paper, we propose a novel method for diagnosis based on the graph convolutional network combining counterfactual analysis. Specifically, we employ the structural causal model to dissociate the direct causal effect of sample quantity on predictions from the total causal effect. We evaluate our proposed method on the data set comprising 10113 health samples and 1127 fault samples. The experimental results demonstrate that our method effectively mitigates the detrimental impact of data imbalance and utilizes health samples to enhance the accuracy of transformer fault diagnosis, particularly in scenarios where fault data is scarce.

articleTitle: Dynamic Scheduling Using Multi-scale Graph Attention Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Dynamic scheduling issues have garnered considerable attention in the realm of network topology-based research. Within power systems, efficient resource allocation and link scheduling, rooted in system networks, are paramount for optimizing power resource utilization and operational efficacy. This paper delves into the distributed link scheduling task within system networks, where a prevalent approach relies on Maximum Weighted Independent Set (MWIS) and greedy algorithms due to the versatility and broad applicability. Nonetheless, these greedy methodologies tend to disregard different ranges of topological information within networks. Different business and regional conflict network structures in power system vary, and different neighborhoods in the conflict network contribute differently to the node's unity function. To adapt to different network structures and comprehensively consider the roles of nodes within different ranges of neighborhoods, this paper proposes a link scheduling algorithm based on multi-scale graph attention feature embedding i.e. Multi-scale Graph Attention based MWIS solver. This solver integrates the combined effects of nodes within multiple neighborhood ranges in the conflict graph by defining different attention scales for graph feature embedding, thereby improving the unity function of the generated scheduling strategy. Experimental results validate the superiority of the proposed multi-scale graph attention feature embedding-based link scheduling algorithm over conventional approaches, affirming the efficacy of multi-scale graph attention features.

articleTitle: Detecting and Exploiting Unit Commitment Structures in MIPs
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The unit commitment (UC) problem has been extensively researched in the literature, which is typically formulated as a mixed integer programming (MIP) problem. However, current studies lack effective methods to identify potential UC problem structures within a general MIP problem, making it challenging to leverage well-established valid inequalities for UC problems to accelerate the solution process. In this paper, we present a novel detection method that automatically identifies UC structures within an MIP problem by analyzing the relationships between variables and constraints. Moreover, we enhance the MIP formulation by incorporating three well-studied classes of valid inequalities as cutting planes, based on the identified UC structures. Our experiments demonstrate that our proposed UC detection method greatly improves computational efficacy of a standard MIP solver compared to the default setting.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Balancing Group Mode in Germany and Its Enlightenment for China’s Power Grid Development
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The German electricity market has a high degree of liberalization, and the balancing group mechanism is the core of its electricity market design. While ensuring that electricity can be freely and flexibly traded in the market, it also ensures the supply-demand balance of the electricity system, which is of great significance for the safety and economic operation of the German power system. This article first briefly introduces the overview of natural resources and power system in Germany, and then analyzes the balancing group from four aspects: basic structure, trading mechanism, key technology, and implementation effect. It also deeply analyzes the operating mechanism of the balancing settlement unit and summarizes the advantages and disadvantages of the German balancing group model. Finally, based on the actual operation of China’s power system, this article summarizes the inspiration of the German balancing group model for the development of China’s power grid.

articleTitle: Dynamic NMGs-based Load Restoration for Resilient Distribution System Considering Multisource Collaboration and Droop Control
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The large amount of distributed generation can provide emergency power supply to critical loads during blackouts and help build resilient distribution systems. This paper examines a distribution system equipped with controlled switch devices and various distributed energy resources, including droop-controlled generators and energy storage systems capable of supplying power. This paper introduces a comprehensive mathematical model for load restoration that integrates network reconfiguration and dynamic networked microgrids formation strategies to optimize both load restoration and cost efficiency. The effectiveness of this model is demonstrated through simulations on modified PG&E 69-node distribution system, showing that our approach significantly reduces load shedding and operational costs, thereby improving the system's resilience to natural disasters. The study effectively underscores the benefits of networked microgrids and multisource collaboration in sustaining critical power supplies during high-impact low-probability events.

articleTitle: Research on Grid-Forming Energy Storage System Based on Hybrid Ultracapacitor
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Wind farms located in remote areas have the problems of weak stability and low grid-connection strength due to the long electrical distance from large power grids and small Short-Circuit Ratio (SCR). Grid-Forming Control technology (GFM) has the characteristics of voltage support and active inertia, which can replace synchro to realize grid support and maintain the stability of power system. Therefore, GFM has broad development and application prospects in new energy power system. Based on this, this paper proposes a grid-forming energy storage system with hybrid ultracapacitors as the energy storage medium and virtual synchronous machine (VSG) control as the control strategy. The energy storage system is connected to the AC side of the wind farm, which can coordinate the energy storage to ensure that the system can smooth the frequency fluctuations and Reduce the Rate of Change of Frequency (ROCOF) when the wind resources fluctuate and the system switches the load. Raise the lowest frequency point; Provide frequency and voltage support when short circuit fault occurs in the system, prevent frequency collapse, and improve the success rate of Low Voltage Ride-Through (LVRT) of wind turbines. Improve grid-connected strength. Finally, based on the MATLAB/Simulink simulation platform, the good dynamic response ability of the energy storage system under the above-mentioned working conditions in each short-circuit ratio scenario is verified.

articleTitle: A Novel Assessment Method for Joint Hosting Capacity of Distributed Wind Generation and Photovoltaic in Multi-level Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: As renewable energy becomes more prevalent, it is crucial to regularly estimate the hosting capacity of distribution networks to ensure safe and stable operation. This paper proposes a novel method for assessing the Joint Hosting Capacity (JHC) of Distributed Photovoltaic (DPV) and Distributed Wind Generation (DWG) in multi-level distribution networks. The historical data is first trained using a hybrid CNN-GRU (convolutional neural networks-gate recurrent unit) neural network. The Bootstrap method is then applied to obtain the simultaneous rates of wind, solar, and load. Based on the simultaneous rates, the JHC of the equipment level, county level and provincial level distribution network is evaluated separately. The final evaluation result of JHC for the entire province are synthesized from the three levels, and the allowed incremental capacities of DPV and DWG are provided. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through a virtual study case, which indicates its high operability and reliable outcomes. The method can provide guidance for the development of new energy sources.

articleTitle: System Dynamics-based Digital Intelligent Substations Domino Chain Safety Protection
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the continuous development of digital intelligent substations, large number of online monitoring devices have been installed in the substation equipment. While the electrical and non-electrical monitoring data of individual equipment as well as the monitoring data of different equipment in the substation have not been comprehensively analyzed and effectively utilized. This paper presents a set of System Dynamics-based Domino chain safety protection model for digital intelligent substations. Firstly, the characteristic variables of the key equipment of substations are selected and classified to investigate the failure probability function of the equipment in different dimensions. Besides, we have researched the chain failure probability function of the upper main equipment to the current one, which combine the Domino chain analysis method. Moreover, the comprehensive failure probability function of the equipment and the failure probability function of the substation system. Furthermore, we analyze the internal causal relationship of the substation according to the electrical main wiring diagram, and construct chain protection System Dynamics flow diagram and System Dynamics equations. What’s more we form a digitized substation Domino chain safety protection model. Finally, a case analysis is carried out with a substation in a certain region, and the results illustrate that the substation Domino chain safety protection model built in this article has expanded from equipment protection to network protection and can more effectively ensure its safe operation.

articleTitle: Research on Abnormal Diagnosis Algorithm of Power Transformer Based on Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Power transformers’ vibration signals such as acoustic patterns are particularly useful in the diagnosis of mechanical type defects such as loose core clamps or faulty windings. Due to the scarcity of anomalous signals from the transformers and the redundancy of normal vibration signals, we focused in our current study on four Generative Adversarial Network(GAN), based on the existing theory, the results are improved accordingly with the actual conditions of transformer operation. In this paper, we use vibration data collected in the field and generate corresponding fault data according to different types of anomalies as a way to test the noise immunity and sensitivity of different algorithms. GAN as a very advanced deep learning theory in recent years, we apply it to transformer anomaly detection and compare it with some traditional methods of machine learning, and the final experimental results show that, deep learning anomaly detection algorithms generally yield higher accuracy rates, and each algorithm works better on its own anomaly detection scenario.

articleTitle: Forecasting of photovoltaic power generation leveraging multi-view attention model
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Forecasting of photovoltaic (PV) power generation is a challenging task since it requires to consider many factors synthetically, such as historical power generation data, meteorological data. The unstable and nonlinear nature of PV power generation contributes to the difficulty. Most existing predictive models rarely focus on the hidden information in the data and fail to capture spatio-temporal dependencies in the data. To address these challenges, we propose a hybrid deep learning framework that combines multi-view time-series representation with an attention mechanism, named Multi-View Attention model for PV Power Generation Prediction (PV-MVAT). Our model improves the accuracy of its predictions by the following two techniques: i) capture key features and information through the multi-view time-series representation technique; ii) leverage the attention mechanism to dynamically adjust the attention weights for different time points and features. Real data simulations from the Elia Group in Belgium demonstrate the viability of our design choices. In particular, compared with the best performance among ten baseline models, our model achieves 16.06%, 8.11% and 7.73% improvement in MSE, MAE and CVRMSE respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Synergistic Development of Green Hydrogen Energy and Different Industries in New Power System —— Taking Xinjiang as an Example
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In the new power system, in order to achieve the goal of double carbon, green hydrogen energy must be developed. Firstly, the industrial advantages of developing green hydrogen energy in Xinjiang are analyzed, and finally some suggestions for developing green hydrogen energy in Xinjiang are given. In the power industry, the development path of green hydrogen can adopt "electricity-hydrogen" and "electricity-hydrogen-electricity" modes to promote the multi-energy complementary application of hydrogen and new energy, and improve the consumption level of new energy and the power grid regulation ability. In chemical industry, hydrogen is widely used in the production of green methanol and ammonia. In the transportation industry, hydrogen fuel cell vehicles are in the initial stage in Xinjiang, and the development path of green hydrogen is mainly aimed at heavy trucks operating in industrial parks and mines. In the steel industry, green hydrogen is used to replace carbon monoxide smelting. In the natural gas industry, the civil natural gas pipeline network is doped with hydrogen.

articleTitle: Analysis of PMSG-based Wind Farm with SVG Based on Parameter Participation Factor
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The High Frequency Resonance (HFR) caused by the interaction between the Static Var Generator (SVG) and the direct-drive Permanent Magnet Synchronous Generator (PMSG) threatens the safe and stable operation of PMSG-based wind farm. To solve this problem, the high frequency impedance models of the PMSG and SVG are established respectively, and the impedance model of the system is obtained after considering the collector line and performing equivalence. Based on the impedance model, the two characteristic roots of the system and their corresponding high-frequency resonant modes are solved, and then using the parameter participation factor to measure the effect of different control parameters on the system stability. The parameters with greater influence ability are called the key factors, and the influence of key factors on the resonance modes is analyzed by using Bode diagram and root locus. Finally, the electromagnetic transient simulation model of PMSG-based wind farm was built on MATLAB/Simulink platform to verify the accuracy of the resonance analysis results.

Author Keywords: PMSG-based wind farm (Permanent Magnet Synchronous Generator)

articleTitle: Methods to Improve the Reactive Power Regulation Capability of Energy Storage Converters for High Penetration of Distributed Photovoltaic Integration in Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Under the incentives of the "dual carbon" target, the proportion of distributed Photovoltaic (PV) integration into distribution networks is rapidly increasing, bringing new momentum to rural revitalization.
